English | [简体中文](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ZH-CN.md)

Build `11140102`.

### Added

- App Audio Library: replace notification sounds with custom audio. Apps not shown in the list can use the capture guide to obtain their notification-sound paths.
- Pairing & Device Connection: used to obtain required paths.

### Changed

- Case-insensitive cache UUID comparison (#131)
- Reject trailing text in date fields (#132)
- Share-inbox fallback (#133)
- Validate backup metadata filenames (#134)
- Reduce cache descriptor string-scan allocations (#135)
- Reuse one preview snapshot for field search (#136)
- Preserve field edits over layout presets (#137)
- Preserve existing plist keys when editing fields (#138)
- Reduce allocations in exact plist comparisons (#139)
- Traverse document differences once (#140)
- Fix Face ID failing after enabling Apple Intelligence (#128)
- Add missing localization for #128 (#146)
- Pairing paths are migrated when a reinstall moves the app data container.

### Fixed

- Fix pairing failure in side-loaded release builds.
- Add the missing Face ID recovery localization strings.
- Fix audio file selection in side-loaded builds.
- Refresh captured sounds immediately and cache the app audio list.
- Show LocalDevVPN guidance and stop capture when the tunnel does not connect.

### Features

- Add a **Subreddit Switcher** choice of **Classic** or **Modern** under Interface → Display & Navigation: Classic brings back Apollo's original Favorites popup for title taps and Posts tab holds, and Modern keeps the search sheet (#1604: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Classic is the default on regular iPhones, so updating from 4.0.x brings the popup back; Modern is the default on iPhone Duo
  - Modern now opens with the keyboard up and starts loading your pick right away, and on the iPhone Duo holding the Posts tab opens the switcher from the side rail and when unfolded
- Add **Jump Button Navigation** so the comment jump button can step through comments posted since your last visit instead of top-level threads; press and hold to go back one (#1506: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Choose Threads (default) or New Comments under Settings → General below Jump Button Position, or from a post's ••• menu; the button shows a NEW label in that mode
- Add **Tint Tab Bar Icons** to give unselected tab icons a muted shade of your theme's accent, on the classic and Liquid Glass tab bars and the iPhone Duo side rail (#1684: @IllIIllIllIllII, @AcornElf)
  - Add **Accent Navigation Buttons** on Liquid Glass to draw Back, toolbar and menu buttons in your theme's accent; titles stay neutral
  - Both are off by default under Settings → Appearance → Theme Manager → Options
- Add **Unread Badges** under Interface to show the Inbox's unread count as a small dot on the tab bar and on the Inbox's Notifications and Chat tabs, and to color unread badges with your theme's accent instead of red (#1680: @icpryde, @AcornElf)
  - Compact Dot on Tab Bar, Compact Dot in Inbox (shown while modern Chat is on) and Theme Color are each off by default
- Show **Hidden & Deleted** in Apollo's own post and comment lists, so results follow your post size, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus, and open their threads like anywhere else (#1485: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Items keep their Hidden, Removed or Deleted label, removed posts keep their saved title and media, and the Posts tab has its own Compact Posts / Large Thumbnails button
- Add a **Spelling** setting under Interface → Display & Navigation: Apollo Reborn's screens now use American spelling to match Apollo, and choosing British changes the whole app's spelling to British (#1648: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Posts, comments, usernames and subreddit names keep the spelling they were written with
- Add **All+** to blend NSFW posts back into r/all by Reddit's own hot ranking, the way old Reddit's r/all showed them (#1472: @nnastasi)
  - Off by default: turn on Show NSFW in r/all under Posts & Feeds → All+; it applies to the Hot, Best and Rising sorts, and an optional NSFW boost slider moves them higher
- Make swipes on the open **iPhone Duo** follow your finger: Back within a pane, closing a thread, opening and closing the subreddit list and leaving a profile, with a forward swipe to bring a closed thread or profile back (#1656: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - With **Disable Left Swipes** on, swipe right anywhere in a pane to go Back, folded or unfolded, while galleries and carousels keep their own swipes (#1476: @nnastasi)
  - Turning Split View on or off no longer squashes post and comment text or makes the title bar jump, and sideways drags no longer open posts or start the text loupe
- Add a **draggable divider** between the feed and thread in the open iPhone Duo's landscape split view: hold the grip and drag to resize, and Apollo remembers your width (#1672: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - It snaps near ⅓, 40%, 50% and 60%; double-tap the grip to return to 50/50
- Use the **Focused feed** layout in open portrait on the iPhone Duo too, and switch layouts from feeds and threads opened in Inbox, Account and Search (#1682, #1652: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Tall images, galleries and videos now fill the Focused column instead of half its width
- Add **tabletop video controls** on the half-folded iPhone Duo: a fullscreen video moves above the fold, with large rewind, play/pause and forward buttons, a timeline, mute, Playback Speed and AirPlay below it (#1591: @nunoo)
  - It turns on by itself when you half-fold with a video open and goes back to the normal viewer when you unfold; on every device, Hold for Video Speed no longer fires when you press a video control

### Fixes

- Load **hot**, **new** and **rising** feeds, **more replies** rows and subreddit icons again on **API-Key-Free** accounts after Reddit started blocking them in early November (#1657, #1666: @DeltAndy123)
  - Installs with Use Route Updates on already picked these up; this version builds them in
- Reload a feed that failed because Reddit's rate limit was reached on **API-Key-Free** accounts once the limit resets, instead of leaving "Couldn't load posts" until you pull to refresh (#1670: @icpryde)
  - The empty list says the posts will load when the limit resets, and the Inbox sends one fewer request at launch
- Keep **API-Key-Free Mode** off after you turn it off, instead of it switching back on at the next launch; the account returns to its API key sign-in, or Apollo asks you to sign in again if that sign-in no longer works (#1627: @icpryde)
- Load **more replies** rows and Inbox replies' parent comments again for **API keys** Reddit started refusing in late October (#1620: @icpryde)
- Keep your **subscribed subreddits** in the subreddit list when Apollo's background refresh fails, often right after returning to the app, instead of showing only Home, Popular and All until you pull to refresh (#1674: @icpryde)
- Fix a crash right after opening Apollo on iOS 27.2 with **Liquid Glass** when you switch away while the navigation buttons are still animating in, and a crash opening Settings → General on some iPhone Duo setups (#1630: @icpryde)
- Fix Apollo **freezing** after closing a comment thread on Liquid Glass, most often in the unfolded iPhone Duo split view (#1515: @nnastasi)
- Show **Reddit API Key Required** when you sign in with an API key before adding one, instead of opening Reddit's login page and failing after you log in; **Add API Key** opens Accounts & API Keys (#1597: @icpryde)
- Post a **GIF from your camera roll** in a comment or reply as the animated GIF instead of a still of its first frame, whichever upload host you use (#1669: @icpryde)
  - Subreddits that allow images but not GIFs in comments still get the still
- Start a **YouTube** video in Apollo's player when iOS refuses to autoplay it, instead of the loading screen spinning forever (#1599: @icpryde)
- Stop showing **"Translated from …"** under short comments, names and stretched words that Google only re-spells when it isn't sure of the language (#1675: @icpryde)
- Open an **Inbox reply** or comment link without the Find in Comments bar flashing over the loading page, the comments jumping after they load, or an imgur image showing a link card first (#1602: @icpryde)
- Reopen **Popular** or **All** at launch with Restore Reading Session on, instead of every tab you open snapping back to Posts for a few seconds and the feed never reopening (#1627: @icpryde)
- Open **Community Highlights** cards again on Apollo 1.14 (iOS 14), along with sidebar and settings links, Search tab results and profile social links that did nothing when tapped since 4.0.0 (#1619: @icpryde)
- Open the right action from a subreddit header's **Sidebar** and **Set User Flair** buttons after reordering or hiding items with **Customize Action Menus** (#1596: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Swipe up on the **Account Switcher**'s list to expand it to full screen and drag down at the top to shrink it, and reorder accounts without the sheet moving (#1645: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - On the closed iPhone Duo the "Accounts" title is centered, and the per-account API key editor fits with Back inside the sheet and Clear Custom Key for This Account visible (#1683: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the **Return Button** after a swipe-back you let go of, instead of it disappearing from a page that stayed open (#1678: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - On the iPhone Duo it is now round like the buttons beside it and stays after List and Split in open portrait
- Point the **Touch ID** prompt at the side button when reopening Apollo in another orientation with Touch ID & Passcode on, instead of a corner of the screen (#1633: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Slide **navigation titles** left into free space on Liquid Glass instead of shrinking them to "…", such as beside a Live Activity on the unfolded iPhone Duo (#1632: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Open the **Delete Multireddit** and **Unsubscribe** confirmations beside the subreddit list's Delete button on Liquid Glass, without a dark circle over the list (#1677: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Polish the **classic (non-Liquid Glass) look** (#1601, #1603, #1605, #1606, #1616, #1617, #1618: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Keep the feed search bar readable and in place: tapping it no longer slides the nav bar away, Cancel puts it back, and the subreddit banner stays visible; with Hide Bars on Scroll, scrolling back up and going back bring the header and nav bar back where they belong
  - Match the rows Apollo Reborn adds to Settings to the height of Apollo's own rows, and let you reorder Settings Shortcuts by dragging
  - Open the account switcher as the usual bottom sheet inside posts, with its buttons in your theme color instead of blue
  - Open the ••• on your own profile as Apollo's action sheet, and show the Return Button as a normal navigation-bar button in your theme color
- Make **Swipe Tab Bar to Navigate** work on the iPhone Duo: swipe down the side rail to go Back and up to go Forward, or along the bottom bar in open portrait, with the page following your finger (#1702: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - On every iPhone, letting go of a Forward swipe early no longer clears your forward history
- Keep the closed **iPhone Duo**'s side rail working when a Live Activity, Moderator or Translate leaves it short of room: More (•••) opens in one tap with Sort, its time ranges and Moderator tools inside, and the subreddit list keeps Edit and Add in the rail (#1473, #1688: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Center **subreddit headers** beside the side rail on the closed iPhone Duo, so the banner, icon and name aren't cut off by the Back button (#1655: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fit the **update prompt** and **What's New** on the closed iPhone Duo, so the version line, Release Notes link and Download IPA aren't cut off and Continue is centered (#1598, #1600: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Open the unfolded **iPhone Duo** to the subreddit list when **Default Reddit to Load** is set to Lists, and keep the list open when unfolding from it, instead of loading Home (#1676: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the **comment jump button** in place while swiping back from a thread on the iPhone Duo, instead of it jumping to the left edge as the swipe starts (#1699: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show the color and icon behind a **swiped comment** in the unfolded iPhone Duo split, instead of an invisible swipe (#1634: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep scrolling responsive right after you fold or unfold the **iPhone Duo**, instead of the first scroll being ignored or put back (#1497: @nnastasi)
- Keep the keyboard up when you tap a search field on the open **iPhone Duo** with another app's video pinned to the top of the screen, instead of it closing right away (#1705: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the iPhone Duo feed layout when **Picture in Picture** or another app sits on top of the open Duo: the Feed Layout button shows, media fits the shorter pane, posts are no longer cut off on the right, and Hide Tab Bar on Scroll works (#1693: @nunoo)
- Stop a **forward swipe** on the open iPhone Duo reopening a page you had already left after picking a subreddit or opening a thread (#1489: @nnastasi)

## Erosion-CN v0.9.1 更新日志 · Bilingual Release Notes (Build 23)

### 🇨🇳 简体中文

#### 🛠️ 关键 Bug 修复：原生 AI 机型 `Personal Translator (#266)` 基线锁定与双向自愈（修复 #16 / #22）
1. **修复旧版（`v0.8.3 – v0.8.5`）误关槽位 `#266` 导致相册云端工具与相机 Siri「0 秒瞬间报错」的问题**：
   - 在所有原生支持 Apple 智能的 iPhone（`iPhone 15 Pro` 至 `iPhone 18 Pro Max` 全系列）原厂 `CacheData` 中，`Personal Translator`（`M1n2sAqf33NAOgZRGxQYBA`，槽位 `#266`）原厂默认为 `true (0x01)`，而 `Audio Intelligence`（`rb2tKZxlj0Gm2tBmUQSLqQ`，槽位 `#178`）原厂默认为 `false (0x00)`。
   - 此前跨 iOS 版本 OTA 升级（旧 `OriginalGestalt.plist` 的 `CacheUUID` 变化）或非 18 Pro 机型执行一键配齐时，可能将 `#266` 误写为 `false (0x00)` 并污染本地 `UserDefaults` 基线快照，触发 `GenerativeModels / ModelCatalog` 本地预检 0ms 熔断报错（端侧快速消除正常，但**照片高质量消除、扩图延伸、重构及相机 `SIRI` 模式**瞬间报错）。
   - `v0.9.1` 已锁定全系原生 AI iPhone 的硬件原厂基线（`#266 = true`、`#178 = false`，免疫跨版本备份不匹配与污染缓存），并在恢复出厂 / 重建缓存 / 重生备份时自动清理本地槽位基线记录。
2. **新增双向异常检测与「一键配齐 / 修复」自愈提示**：
   - 顶部「Apple 智能激活四要素体检」卡片、实时 `MGCopyAnswer` 核验与防呆护栏现可**双向检测**槽位偏移（无论 `#178` 被强开为 `true` 还是原生 AI 机型的 `#266` 被误关为 `false`）；
   - 受旧版影响的用户升级 `v0.9.1` 后，打开 `MobileGestalt` 点击顶部 **「一键配齐 / 修复」→「应用」→ 手动关机冷重启** 即可完整恢复原厂基线。
3. **单包中英双语同步更新**：新增诊断提示词条已 100% 同步内置简体中文 (`zh-Hans`) 与英文 (`en`) 双语翻译。

---

### 🌐 English

#### 🛠️ Critical Bug Fix: `Personal Translator (#266)` Factory Baseline Lock & Two-Way Auto-Heal (Fixes #16 / #22)
1. **Fixed instant 0ms failure in Photos Cloud Tools (High-Quality Clean Up / Extend / Reframe) & Camera `SIRI` caused by slot `#266` downgrade**:
   - On all native Apple Intelligence iPhones (`iPhone 15 Pro` through `iPhone 18 Pro Max`), factory `CacheData` sets `Personal Translator` (`M1n2sAqf33NAOgZRGxQYBA`, slot `#266`) to `true (0x01)` and `Audio Intelligence` (`rb2tKZxlj0Gm2tBmUQSLqQ`, slot `#178`) to `false (0x00)`.
   - Earlier versions (`v0.8.3 – v0.8.5`) could accidentally flip slot `#266` to `false (0x00)` on non-18-Pro models or after an OTA iOS update (`CacheUUID` change) and cache that polluted baseline in `UserDefaults`, causing `GenerativeModels / ModelCatalog` to abort locally in 0ms while Fast Clean Up still worked.
   - `v0.9.1` enforces the verified hardware factory baseline (`#266 = true`, `#178 = false`) across all native AI iPhones and purges stale `UserDefaults` slot baselines on Factory Restore / Clean Cache Rebuild / Backup Regeneration.
2. **Two-Way Slot Drift Detection & One-Click Auto-Heal**:
   - Both the 4-Factor Readiness Checkup Card and live `MGCopyAnswer` verification now detect drift in **both directions** (`#178` forced ON or `#266` accidentally turned OFF on native AI hardware) and expose **One-Click Setup / Repair** immediately.
   - To heal an affected device: install `v0.9.1` → open **Tweaks → MobileGestalt** → tap **One-Click Setup / Repair** → **Apply** → **power off and cold-reboot**.

---

## iPadn 2.1.0

本次更新为历史版本加入对应版本的真实图标与 IPA 大小，完善下载交互、自动安装和本机应用详情，并修复侧滑裁剪、重复安装排队及搜索标签圆角问题。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

### 历史版本

- 新增起止日期范围查询（包含结束日全天），逐步检查当前来源提供的版本，显示进度并支持取消、清除筛选；失败或日期未知会明确提示结果不完整，不按版本 ID 猜日期，也不会遇到一条范围外的日期就停止。包内时间戳标记为「包内日期」，不等同于商店发布日期。
- 展开和筛选结果按每批 20 条追加；可见历史行延迟触发读取，滑离时取消排队，先显示版本资料再补图标。图标在后台解码，并以最多 80 张 / 8 MiB 的内存缓存减少反复滚动的开销。日期扫描不主动读取图标。

- 每个历史版本行内显示从对应 IPA 提取的主图标，便于比较活动角标；按需局部读取、分版本缓存，未获取时显示占位，不使用最新版商店图标代替。仅存储在 Assets.car 中的图标暂不支持。
- 显示每个版本对应的 IPA 安装包大小，而不是套用最新版的大小；读取已有元数据即可取得远端完整包大小，无需先下载整个安装包。
- 版本号、日期、大小和版本 ID 分层显示，大字体下自动纵向排列。
- 长按版本行，通过系统菜单复制版本号或版本 ID；点击菜单外即可收起。
- 兼容旧元数据缓存；无法读取大小时显示「—」。大小是远端原始 IPA 的长度，可能与下载处理后的本地文件略有差异。

### 下载与操作体验

- 下载卡片侧滑可删除或分享，分享文件名包含应用名称与版本号。
- 修复侧滑时卡片边缘被裁剪、快速滑动后分享按钮短暂变灰的问题；整张圆角卡片一起移动，收起后恢复原样。
- 点侧滑操作以外的位置即可收起，不会顺带触发下面的按钮。修正掉帧时弹簧动画推进过慢、收起后操作恢复延迟的问题。
- 删除后的 5 秒撤销提示显示剩余秒数和进度环。
- 下载完成时进度环转为勾号，再显示「安装」；任务长按保留原生系统菜单。
- 再点当前标签页可回到列表顶部，切换其他标签仍保留原来的滚动位置。

### 自动安装与实时活动

- 开启「下载完成后自动安装」并选择「原生安装」时，完成的下载依次直接安装，无需再次确认。需事先完成配对，并保持 LocalDevVPN 连接；其他安装方式仍需打开 iPadn 完成确认。
- 下载到安装期间保留静音音频后台保活；标准版的锁屏和灵动岛实时活动可显示下载、处理和安装状态。后台运行仍受 iOS 管理，应用被系统终止时不能保证继续；重新打开后恢复待办。
- 修复安装中切回前台可能将同一任务再次加入队列；隔离预览模式的安装待办记录，避免影响正式数据。

### 搜索与稳定性

- 最近搜索改为标签显示，可在设置中关闭搜索页的「发现」。
- 修复最近搜索标签换行后左侧圆角被列表裁剪的问题，保留原生长按菜单。
- 本机应用分组改用「App Store 未识别的应用」，表述更清晰。
- 本机应用查不到商店资料时仍可点开查看已装版本、Bundle ID 等本机信息；区分当前地区未查到资料与查询失败，可独立重试商店查询，不将缺少资料直接判为下架。
- 补充历史版本大小、旧缓存迁移、长按复制、大字体与侧滑表面的回归测试；改进模拟器启动等待及撤销测试的操作时序，不改变实际撤销期限。
- 继续支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本，各功能保留各自系统版本要求。

### 两个安装包

- `iPadn-2.1.0-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动和小组件，签名需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.1.0-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能相同。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可添加源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`。

### English

**Date-range search** includes the whole end day and checks every version returned by the current source, with progress, cancellation and explicit incomplete/unknown-date states. It does not infer dates from IDs or stop at the first out-of-range date. Package timestamps are labeled as package dates, not guaranteed store release dates. Histories and filtered results load in batches of 20; visible rows publish metadata before reading icons, cancelled rows leave the queue promptly, and background-decoded images share a bounded 80-image / 8 MiB cache. The date scan itself does not fetch icons.

**Version history** now shows each version’s own primary icon extracted from its IPA, alongside the remote IPA size of that individual version, using partial metadata reads rather than downloading the whole package or reusing the latest listing's size. Version, date, size and ID are separated, with a vertical layout for accessibility text sizes. Long-press a row to copy its version number or ID using the system menu. Old caches remain compatible; unavailable sizes show “—”. The remote raw IPA size can differ slightly from the processed local download. Icon PNGs are fetched with bounded range reads and cached per platform/app/version; no full package download is needed. Missing icons use placeholders, never current store artwork. Icons stored only in Assets.car are not yet supported.

**Downloads** gain swipe-to-delete/share with app-and-version filenames, full-card movement without clipped edges, reliable Share appearance after fast swipes, and outside-tap dismissal without activating underlying controls. Spring timing follows real elapsed time so dropped frames do not prolong closing animations. Undo retains its five-second window with a countdown ring. Completion transitions to a checkmark and Install. Task long-press keeps the native menu; tapping the selected tab scrolls to the top without resetting other tabs.

**Automatic native installation** installs completed downloads sequentially without another confirmation when enabled. Pair beforehand and keep LocalDevVPN connected; other methods still need foreground confirmation. Silent audio keeps the app running from download through installation, with download/processing/install states in standard-package Live Activities. Background execution remains subject to iOS; reopening resumes pending work. Fixes duplicate queuing of an active installation on foreground return and isolates preview installation records from real data.

**Installed apps** stay inspectable even when store details are missing: open local version, Bundle ID and other device information, distinguish a missing regional listing from a failed lookup, and retry store details without reconnecting the native installation service.

Recent searches use chips with corrected wrapped rounded edges, Discover can be hidden in Settings, and regression coverage and simulator readiness are improved. iOS / iPadOS 16 remains supported, subject to each feature's requirements. Both unsigned packages are available: standard includes Live Activities/widgets and needs two App IDs; lite has no extension and needs one. Sign with your own tool before installing.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

两个安装包：`iPadn-2.1.0-unsigned.ipa` 是标准版（含实时活动和桌面小组件，需要 2 个 App ID）；`iPadn-2.1.0-lite-unsigned.ipa` 是精简版（不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID），适合 App ID 数量受限的签名方式。

验证：设备 Release 编译与 IPA 检查通过；162 项测试通过，0 项失败，0 项跳过。

> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 26.7.1 and the 27.3 beta (confirmed by a user).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.6

## New

- **Search Inside Folders…** (••• menu): finds names in all subfolders, with progress and **Stop**.
- **Largest Files** (••• menu): the 100 biggest files below a folder, to see where storage goes.
- **Get Info** (long-press): path, kind, size (folders counted), dates, owner, permissions, inode and a file's SHA-256. Tap a row to copy it.
- **Duplicate** and **Copy to Folder…** (long-press): copy files and folders, also into other apps' data, like Move.
- **Favorites:** add a folder from its ••• menu; they're listed under Tools.
- **Reopen Last Folder** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): WQ Files starts in the folder you were in. It's a switch on the start screen.
- **Check for Updates** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): a note on the start screen when a new version is out.
  - **What's sent:** WQ Files reads the public release list on GitHub at most twice a day and sends nothing about your device. This is its only network access.
  - **Turning it off:** use the switch on the start screen.
- **Open ZIP files by tapping them** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): **Extract and Open** unpacks it next to itself and opens the folder. **Open as File** shows the file as before.
- **Thai** ([#52](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/52)).

## Changed

- **SQLite save** writes through SQLite itself, which takes care of the database's journal and WAL files, so a save is safer if WQ Files is closed midway.
- **App restore** copies and checks the backup in a private folder first, and installs exactly what was checked.
- **Replace All** when importing only replaces the file versions shown in the question; a file that changed meanwhile is imported under a new name.
- **Turkish and Thai:** clearer wording.

## Fixed

- **App names and some app folders missing** on some devices (e.g. iOS 26.1): when the app database uses a layout WQ Files doesn't know, it now works out where names and folders are from the database itself, and remembers it for that iOS version. App identities, which decide where backups go, still only come from the app's own folder tag or a known layout. WQ Files also uses the newest database file when iOS keeps an old one, and the Log lists them.
- **App backups could come out empty** when WQ Files didn't have access to the app's folder yet; it worked on the second or third try. Backup now fails with "try again" instead, and an empty backup is never restored (restoring one would empty the app's data).

## Credit

Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Translations: iosrxwy (Simplified Chinese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian). Thanks to everyone who sent Logs and ideas. GPL-3.0-or-later.

### 新增

- Windows 新增 AnimeJaNai 实时超分：播放器底栏一键开关，可与 Anime4K、DLSS 叠加；支持 TensorRT / DirectML 后端自动选择，提供质量、均衡、性能三档与原版、Sharp1 两种模型，附细节锐化、亮度、对比度、饱和度、伽马调节及原画/超分同帧对比。
- AnimeJaNai 可选 RIFE 补帧：支持 2×、3×、4× 倍率，提供完整（原分辨率处理）与快速（最高 540p 处理）两种方案。
- 新增“画质设置”面板，整合 AnimeJaNai 与 DLSS 全部选项；播放器内长按增强按钮或进入“实验室”页面均可打开，运行状态、安装进度与诊断信息集中展示。
- Windows 播放器底栏常显 Anime4K / AnimeJaNai / DLSS 开关，点按切换、长按进入画质设置，无需先在实验室开启。
- 评论区改版：正文按 Markdown / BBCode 渲染，评论中的时间点自动识别为跳转链接，点击可seek到对应进度或指定集数；表情贴图正常显示，加载时改用骨架占位。

### 优化

- 更新优化内置源规则
- DLSS 与 AnimeJaNai 运行库改由组织维护的 media-kit fork 统一打包，应用内不再捆绑原生桥接代码，减小安装体积。
- 充分优化日志系统
- 优化了一些小细节

### 使用说明

- AnimeJaNai 仅支持 Windows；首次启用需联网下载运行库与模型（补帧组件约 441 MiB），下载过程可取消，TensorRT 后端首次使用需编译引擎。
- 后端设为“自动”时，支持的 NVIDIA 显卡优先使用 TensorRT，其余显卡使用 DirectML。
- AnimeJaNai 模型按 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 分发，仅限非商业用途。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AniBakaBaka/AniBaka/compare/5.2.3+1020...5.2.4+1101

versions.localizedDescription: - 适配 flutter 3.50

### 升级前请先转移数据

**Bundle ID 从 `com.example.kazumi` 改为 `com.linkpass.kazumi`**，不再与上游 Kazumi 共用标识，可加入同一个 AltStore 源（[#26](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/26)）。系统会把新版视为独立 App，**旧数据不会自动迁移；确认迁移完成前请勿删除旧版**。

1. **设置**：在旧版「设置 → 同步设置 → 设置备份」选择「导出到文件」，可以直接存到新版 Kazumi 的文稿目录，也可以存 iCloud 云盘或任意文件夹；装好新版后在同一页选择「从文件恢复」。也可以走「导出到剪贴板／从剪贴板恢复」。若勾选「不含账号与密码」，需在新版重新填写账号凭据。
2. **离线下载的番剧**：在「文件」App 里把旧版 Kazumi 文件夹里的「下载」整个移到新版 Kazumi 文件夹里就行（两个版本可共存，文件夹里空的那个是新版）。之后在新版重新点这几集的下载，会认出已有文件并补回下载记录，不重新下载视频。
3. **规则与规则仓库**：从正式版 3.0.4 导出的设置备份不含规则和仓库；规则需在旧版「规则管理」中另外导出，再在新版导入，自定义仓库需重新添加。3.0.5 起的新备份才会把它们一起保存。
4. **追番与观看历史**：设置备份不含这两类数据。需要保留时，先在旧版完成 Bangumi／WebDAV 同步，再在新版导入设置后同步相应数据。

**设置备份也不包含下载记录。** 确认所需数据已转移后再卸载旧版。

### 新增

- 新增 macOS 26 及以上版本（Mac Catalyst），仅支持 Apple Silicon，不支持 Intel Mac。提供拖拽安装的 dmg，与 iOS 版共用界面及 mpv 播放内核
- 设置备份带上已安装的规则与添加的规则仓库：规则存整份定义，恢复时同名覆盖、没有的新增；规则仓库按地址去重合并

### 修复

- 已下载剧集从「观看历史」（含「我的」页卡片）进入时先播本地文件，断网也能接着看；进度写回原来的记录，在线选集在后台补回，不再挡住起播（[#27](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/27)）
- 从推荐页「热门番组」「本季新番」等更多列表进入详情再返回时，不再重置到列表顶部（[#29](https://github.com/LinkPass888/Kazumi-Swift/issues/29)）
- AniSkip 跳片头、片尾使用精确跳转，不再停在目标之前的关键帧
- 修复退出播放器或换集后，迟到的画中画取帧任务访问已销毁内核导致的崩溃

### 优化

- 详情页在宽屏（可用宽度 ≥ 860）改三栏：封面、条目信息、简介三等分；「开始观看」固定在右下角，竖栏不再重复一遍番名
- 详情页顶栏交回系统：返回键与玻璃背景由系统提供，不再自绘工具栏；辅助功能字号下仍走原来的单栏布局
- 推荐页在矮窗口（可用高度 < 760）改叠压卡：封面铺满，番名与按钮压在底部渐隐上；卡内文字左对齐并收起简介，标题按背景切换深浅
- 播放页在 iPad、Duo 内屏这类常规宽度就地铺开全屏，不再强制转屏；画面按窗口宽度与画面比例定高，控制层逐边避让安全区
- 「我的」页最近观看卡片：番名支持两行，补上播放／重看角标与来源、时间
- 最近搜索胶囊按文字宽度排布，空间不足时整颗换行，不再挤在等宽格子里
- 设置页的横向边距交回系统，Duo 合上时不再压到右边栏
- 观看历史右上角「清空」与返回按钮同色，不再跟主题色走
- 应用内的仓库链接换到新仓库名 Kazumi-Swift，不再多走一次旧名跳转

versions.localizedDescription:
## Why 0.9.95 and not 1.0.0?

This release has almost everything planned for 1.0.0: a new design, a rebuilt player and hundreds of fixes. But so much has changed that it needs testing on more devices and libraries than we can cover ourselves.

So 0.9.95 is the last step before 1.0.0. The goal now is stability, not new features. If something breaks or looks wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/issues) with your device and app version. 1.0.0 will come once this version has proven solid.

## Highlights

* **Shiori, a new design for the whole app:** every screen has been redrawn on one design system, with new navigation, transitions and an ergonomic pass throughout (#1077).
* **A rebuilt video player:** new controls on phone, desktop and TV, plus video filters, audio delay, and volume, brightness and fit kept between episodes.
* **A tracker with no account:** follow your status, progress, score and dates on the device alone (#1121).
* **Work that keeps going on Android:** downloads, library updates, restores and syncs continue in the background, under one notification (#1092).
* **More control over downloads and updates:** download ahead while reading, download new chapters automatically, and choose which series a library update skips (#1091).

**Before updating:** this is a large release that also touches how your library is stored, so make a backup first (More > Backup and restore).

## Reader

* Zoom with Ctrl (⌘ on macOS) and the mouse wheel; the wheel alone moves a zoomed page.
* With "Navigate to pan" on, tall pages are read row by row before the page turns.
* Split tall images into slices in webtoon mode.
* Choose which chapters next and previous skip: read, filtered or duplicate.
* Rebind the reader's keyboard shortcuts.
* Separate icons for crop borders on and off.
* Pages and zooms follow your finger more closely, and the webtoon strip glides after a fling.
* Decoded images now have a memory limit, so long chapters no longer keep growing in memory.
* Fixed: lost decoded pages for the next chapter when closing the reader, and chapter list rows with a scanlator failing to lay out.

## Video player

* New controls on phone, desktop and TV, with episodes reachable from the top bar and lock and skip under the timeline on mobile.
* **Video filters:** brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and hue, kept for the next episodes. Gamma is hidden where the video output cannot apply it.
* **Audio delay:** from -5 to +5 seconds.
* Remember volume and brightness between episodes, and keep the fit from one episode to the next.
* New "Turn subtitles on" switch, so episodes can start without subtitles.
* "Use my subtitle style" now really gives the default style back when turned off.
* VAAPI and VDPAU hardware decoding on Linux.
* Rebind the player's keyboard shortcuts.
* Fixed: a freeze in the player's event handling, crashes when chapter marks change, previous and next buttons on mobile, and controls under the camera cutout in landscape.

## Library and browsing

* Swipe sideways to switch between Manga, Anime and Novels, in the library and in Browse.
* Select everything between two entries, in the library and in chapter lists.
* Skip completed series, series with unread chapters or series not started in library updates. The categories' "Skip updates" option now takes effect too.
* The Updates badge counts what was found since you last opened Updates, and clears when you visit.
* Hidden media types are respected everywhere: Browse, Updates, History and the tracker library.
* Browse remembers the Sources or Extensions page picked for each media.
* Recommendation cards use the available space and no longer show HTML tags.
* Fixed: opening Updates and History with orphan chapters, and an empty random entry.

## Downloads

* Download the next 2, 3, 5 or 10 unread chapters while reading.
* Download new chapters after a library update.
* "Delete download after reading" can remove a chapter 1 to 4 back instead, and keeps bookmarked chapters.
* Failed downloads wait before retrying, and follow what a server asks after a 429 or 503.
* Fixed: complete downloads being held back by the series cover, and resumed archives not finishing.

## Tracking

* New on-device tracker, with its own shelf in the tracker library.
* Redrawn tracking card.
* Progress now reaches trackers even if you leave the screen first.

## Extensions

* Updates are found in every repository, and the app says which one they come from. An update from another repository asks for confirmation before it is installed.
* Extension WebViews are hosted for the extension server, including network and media capture.
* Faster extension installs.
* Repositories with empty source lists are supported.
* Fixed: sources that read a setting in their headers failing to install, and video qualities lost with multiple hosters.

## Backup, restore and sync

* Reading time and last-read dates are kept when restoring backups from other apps.
* Anime is kept from backups of unrecognised forks.
* Local archive favorites are included in backups.
* A backup password is only requested when the password is really the problem.
* Refreshing a catalog keeps your reading state, and duplicate chapters are merged safely.
* Fixed: logging in to the sync server on macOS.

## Security and privacy

* **Secure screen:** keep the app out of screenshots and the recent apps preview, always or only in incognito mode.
* **Lock after:** ask to authenticate after 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes away, or only when the app starts.

## Updates and first launch

* Onboarding starts by asking for your language.
* Clearer update dialog: installed and new version, date, size, sorted notes and what happens next. You will see it from the next update onwards.
* Pre-releases are now ordered correctly when checking for updates.
* New open source licenses screen in About.
* New Persian translation, and the missing strings translated in every language.

## Platforms

* **Android:** fixed a crash where all files access cannot be granted.
* **Android TV:** fixed the Player settings in the anime-only layout, and the repository added on the welcome screen is filed under anime.
* **iOS:** local files stay inside their folder.
* **macOS:** the app icon now fits the system's icon grid.
* **Windows:** sharper 256 px icon, used by the installer too, and more readable crash reports.
* **Linux:** choose which browser opens external links; JPEG is read whichever libjpeg version is installed; fixed webview window crashes.

## Stability and performance

* Faster database queries and lower memory use.
* The next chapter preloads on a new page rather than on every frame.
* A page that lost its data now offers a way back instead of crashing.
* The startup error screen says what to do when the database cannot open.
* Handled errors are now recorded, and developer mode shows them with their details.

## Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release: @adobex, @aliafshany, @itsyaba, @Lukas-DS, @matsukiender-star, @MenaHere, @NBA2K1 and @Totara-thib.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.9...v0.9.95

# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

## Install and test

Download `iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.6-build145.ipa` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the hash, then sign/sideload using your own coherent development main/helper profiles. Keep `MadeiraJITHelper.appex` and debugging permission; signing alone does not activate JIT. Back up saves and keep the same app identity when upgrading—uninstalling can erase local data.

Open iDeck and follow the highlighted setup step; fully close/reopen when prompted after installing Steam64. For on-device pairing use iOS27; iOS26 offers pairing-file import. Activate JIT again for each new app process.

The IPA includes the local runtime and pinned source-built open support components, **no Valve Steam client/libcef, games, accounts, maintainer profile or pairing file**. The installer acquires the client from Valve. Both source companions, relink, license/audit and inventory/checksum assets accompany this release.

## What was verified

The user reports Build144 installation can complete. Build145 passed host ordering/skip/restart/signing/VA checks, installer/rollback/privacy regressions, existing JIT integration checks and full Xcode compilation. Its separate Fresh Test version was development-signed, installed/read back and opened on an iPhone15ProMax; original iDeck was preserved. The public ad-hoc IPA was audited (1480files, no findings), and its105-input relink ran with all30TEXT section hashes matching.

The complete revised145 first-run UI, another-device sideload/JIT, new Steam login and repeated gameplay have **not** received a new acceptance result; the public IPA was not installed again after ad-hoc packaging. iPad, Bluetooth and arbitrary games are not validated by this release. Full independent-machine/offline runtime rebuilding is not claimed.

## Limits that still matter

- **Third game return may freeze Steam.** Report the first failing stage and game-cycle count.
- Steam64 does **not** enlarge the device’s virtual address space. Unsupported layouts can still fail;32-bit games/helpers may still hit separate limits. Guards remain enabled.
- The compatibility snapshot is **Steam manifest1769025840 (January22,2026), CEF126**, held to its matched components. It is not the latest Steam/Chromium and has security/compatibility limitations; future snapshots need fresh review.
- Game support remains limited. No DRM, authentication or anti-cheat bypass is provided. Never post credentials, Steam Guard data, pairing files, profiles or raw personal logs.

See [the four-step guide](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/STEAM64_SETUP.md), [Build145 evidence](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/release/BUILD145_RESULTS.md) and the bilingual README.

# LinuxRunner v1.0.1

Linux on your iPhone and iPad. This update adds iPad desktop adaptations, brings Arch Linux ARM into the setup workflow and improves package recovery and desktop sessions.

## What's New

- **iPad support:** window-aware desktop sizing, hardware-keyboard desktop shortcuts and the shared touch/pointer interface. Tested on a physical iPad.
- **Arch Linux ARM:** install signed packages, use `pacman` and explore an experimental Openbox desktop with LXQt Panel and PCManFM-Qt.
- **One setup workflow:** **Distributions → Set Up Linux…** installs a distribution or configures an existing environment while preserving its files and accounts.

The maintainer reports a working Arch graphical desktop and graphical application launches on a physical iPhone using **build 897**. Telegram Desktop has been tested on Arch Linux ARM with login, sending messages and calls. The supplied iPhone capture shows its welcome screen.

## Improvements

Arch desktop defaults provide a visible panel, wallpaper and file manager without replacing the user's normal LXQt configuration. Managed graphical launches share the active account's authenticated X11 context. Desktop startup status and Qt diagnostics are more useful when a component fails.

IPA packaging now includes an ad-hoc code signature and a standard ZIP layout. It still needs a compatible signing/provisioning method for ordinary device installation.

## Bug Fixes

- Arch terminal termios2 compatibility.
- Signed cached-package recovery and consistent handling of orphaned GCC ownership/obsolete recovery state.
- Qt X11 launch-context failures and desktop profile defaults.
- Reopening existing desktop sessions and readiness after component crashes.
- ARM64 vDSO executable mapping and covered filesystem/syscall compatibility gaps.

## Supported Distributions

| Distribution | Experience |
| --- | --- |
| Debian GNU/Linux 13 ARM64 | Recommended terminal and LinuxRunner Desktop; KDE Plasma remains experimental. |
| Arch Linux ARM | Terminal, `pacman` and experimental Openbox/LXQt-component desktop. |
| Alpine Linux 3.24 ARM64 | Small terminal environment with `apk`; graphical compatibility remains experimental. |

## Installation

Download the release IPA and sign/install it with your preferred compatible sideloading tool, such as Sideloadly or AltStore Classic. Then use **Distributions → Set Up Linux…** to install Linux inside the app.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner#installation) and [Linux setup walkthrough](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md). When updating, back up important files and preserve the existing app identity and App Group configuration. Do not uninstall the app as a repair step.

## Known Limitations

The application interprets ARM64 Linux userspace; it does not boot a Linux kernel, require JIT or use hardware virtualization. System-call and application coverage is incomplete. The configured minimum is iOS/iPadOS 15.0; model/OS compatibility is not universal. iPad support has been physically tested. An older iPhone 11/iOS 17 launch-black-screen report is unresolved.

Arch desktop, Debian KDE Plasma and Metal acceleration remain experimental. Arch Plasma/Wayland is unavailable. Some Arch GTK/glycin programs still encounter write-seal compatibility problems. Large applications can be slow or exceed memory limits. iOS/iPadOS may suspend or terminate the app; saved files persist, running processes do not survive termination.

## Downloads

- **LinuxRunner-1.0.1.ipa** — ad-hoc signed, without an Apple provisioning profile. Install with your preferred compatible signing/sideloading method.
- **LinuxRunner-1.0.1-source.tar.gz** — matching application source and build scripts, pinned build dependencies, matching Alpine source inputs and terminal-renderer sources.
- **LICENSES.txt** — project and third-party license notices.
- **SHA256SUMS** — checksums for the IPA, source archive and license notices.

The IPA is **14,646,386 bytes**. Verify the original download before signing it; signing changes its checksum.

```text
c571c7ae1dd8ab641930e513254866658dc94f0bee370f1d2623cd462f0fa2ca  LinuxRunner-1.0.1.ipa
```

GitHub automatic source archives omit submodule contents. Use the separately attached source asset for the dependency-inclusive source distribution.

## Feedback and License

[Report reproducible problems through GitHub Issues](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/issues/new/choose), including your device, OS, app version/build, distribution and diagnostic report. Review logs/screenshots for personal information before attaching them.

LinuxRunner derives from [iSH](https://github.com/ish-app/ish) through [ios-linuxkit](https://github.com/rcarmo/ios-linuxkit). The combined application is GPL-3.0-covered; upstream copyright, contribution-specific terms, App Store terms and third-party notices are preserved. See the repository's [license](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/LICENSE.md) and [third-party notices](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

# ⚠️This build is OUTDATED. Please use [nightly version](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly) instead.

# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

# RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

## 🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

- **Assassin’s Creed:** audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
- Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to **Vulkan/MoltenVK**.
- Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
- **Black Ops II:** corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
- **Black Ops II:** earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
- Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
- **Assassin’s Creed:** corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
- Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
- **God of War III:** removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
- **God of War III v1.00:** the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
- **Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6:** corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
- Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
- More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
- Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
- Repositioned the **Menu** and **Performance** buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
- Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

## 🕹️ Nintendo Switch — MeloNX

- Support for the **keyboard requested by games**, plus touch access to **L3/R3**.
- Corrected controller handling during sessions and when returning to the interface.
- First-frame and GPU-transfer corrections targeting **black screens at launch**.
- Graphics ordering corrections targeting stale frames, flickering and rendering artifacts.
- Corrected shader resource declarations and compilation paths that could prevent parts of a scene from rendering.
- JIT corrections covering branches, translation-block boundaries and register-state preservation.
- Fewer repeated allocations, improved texture reuse and release of resources no longer needed.
- Improved memory-pressure handling and cleanup of resources retained after closing a session.
- **More durable shader and pipeline caches:** saves during gameplay and on pause, background loading and improved reuse between sessions.
- Preparation of previously encountered graphics variants to reduce their reconstruction during gameplay.
- Reduced redundant graphics-resource updates and improved sharing of Metal libraries between compilation workers.
- **Hogwarts Legacy** corrections covering texture copies and handling of certain invalid graphics values.
- Failure to start the iOS audio engine no longer directly aborts the application.
- Compilation cancellation during teardown addresses sessions stuck on “closing,” including the SSBU path.
- Corrected a MoltenVK presentation ownership race: an in-flight presentation retains the drawable it needs.
- Added a fragmentation guard to avoid unnecessary blocking memory cleanup, targeting pauses reproduced from **Super Smash Bros. Ultimate** logs.

## 🎨 Skins and touch controls

- Added **GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket** skins.
- Added **Pocket — Original** variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
- Added **Switch Pocket**, available through **Skins in the Switch playlist menu**.
- Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
- Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
- Corrected **rectangular press highlights**, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
- GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.
- Bundled skin updates now refresh older installed copies while preserving your selections.
- Restored access to **Skins from the PS2 playlist**.
- Corrected the return from the MeloNX in-game menu so skin buttons and sticks regain input immediately.
- Improved game-screen framing inside Pocket skins, including rounded corners.
- Refined pressed-button visuals so controls sink into their housings rather than simply turning gray.
- Dolphin and PS2 floating session buttons no longer cover skin controls when the skin provides its own Menu button.

## 🏆 RetroAchievements

- Centralized sign-in and **Hardcore** settings.
- Corrected repeated sign-outs, credential persistence and migration of older accounts.
- Improved session ownership of notifications and progress, including external-display presentation.
- Achievement text follows the app language when the required Apple translation features are available.
- Improved game recognition, including **CHD and CSO**, with consistent identification in the library and during play.
- Clearer messages distinguish an unrecognized game from an unreadable file.

## 🧩 Cheats & Enhancements

- A unified **Cheats & Enhancements** page for each game.
- Access to compatible frame-rate, aspect-ratio, graphics and other available game patches.
- Improved activation, deactivation and restoration of original settings.
- **Corrected unintended Switch cheat activation** when the enable list was missing.
- Cheat state remains usable after the app container moves.
- RewindBox-generated cheat files now contain only the selected programs.

## 📚 Library, artwork and manuals

- Reworked 3D cases with more faithful proportions, relief, spines and backs.
- Editable back covers and nondestructive image correction.
- Artwork matching using the ROM’s actual game identifier.
- More reliable batch scraping with better preservation of existing media.
- Improved **French cover and manual** lookup with additional sources.
- Improved scan viewing and zoom.
- Lighter Switch discovery avoids reading entire game files on the main thread.

## ✨ Interface and navigation

- New **RewindBox Glacier** style with a reversible preset.
- Bundled offline system artwork.
- Corrections to margins, obscured titles, icon sizes and carousels.
- Corrections to system bubbles and the “⋯” menu.
- An **icons-only main navigation bar**, while retaining accessible names for VoiceOver.

## 🧪 Experimental renderer

- Added an **optional native Metal 4 renderer for RPCS3**. Vulkan/MoltenVK remains available and the selected renderer is preserved.

## Testing and known limits

The downloaded Build 721 IPA passed the recorded offline package, source/component identity and delivery checks. RPCS3 Core 919 and MeloNX Core 719 are included. Fresh Flutter, native and delivery-contract checks were executed for this delivery. The downloaded file matches the original private delivery byte for byte.

Automated tests and desktop benchmarks do not establish iPhone FPS, audio or gameplay improvements. The complete package has not been gameplay-validated on a physical iPhone. First-use shader compilation and game-specific issues may remain. Cheats and achievement support depend on the game, version and engine.

Long Hogwarts Legacy pauses and residual BO2 performance problems remain under investigation. This build retains automatic BO2/God of War III comparison windows; their removal belongs to a later build and is not included here.

Some faithful Pocket layouts have small touch targets or Dynamic Island overlap. Switch Pocket’s HOME and Capture controls are unavailable in this engine; MeloNX does not lock session orientation through the skin. The MeloNX Metal binary-archive prototype, Switch 2 experiment and RPCS3 comparison-only Cores are not included.

## Download and installation

**IPA:** [RewindBox-0.0.11.ipa](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/releases/download/0.0.11/RewindBox-0.0.11.ipa)

**SideStore / AltStore Classic source:** [source.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/Claude/source.json)

- Requires **iOS 18.0 or later**.
- Re-sign with SideStore, AltStore Classic or your usual compatible sideloading tool. This is not a notarized AltStore PAL package or a directly installable Apple distribution build.
- Public release: **0.0.11**. IPA metadata remains **0.0.8, Build 721**; the source preserves those exact values and uses `marketingVersion` to display 0.0.11.
- Size: **267,033,667 bytes**.
- SHA-256: `bc640a83a01de8a623c16fb0b5977edf16ac6010b61c9c2489ae334d3db3c0d7`.

No firmware, keys, BIOS or game files are bundled.

- **External drives:** **Settings › Storage › External drives › Add a drive or folder** adds a drive (a USB-C SSD or a stick) or a folder on it; you can add several. Each drive appears in Windows as `C:\External\<name>` and as a drive letter.
  - **Find games** adds the games on a drive to your library, and the drive's Steam libraries are found by themselves: their games start through BCD Dock like any other Steam game.
  - A Steam game's page offers **External drive** for a new install (**Steam installs** in the same settings picks the default place), and Steam updates and repairs a game in the library it lives in.
  - **Location › Move to** on a game's page moves a Steam game, or a game you added from Files, between the device and a drive: it copies the game, checks the copy, then deletes the original. The game keeps its settings, Workshop items and launch options.
  - Before a download, files already on the disk are checked once, so a repaired or moved game is not downloaded again.
  - The earlier External SSD folder becomes a drive by itself, with its games and their settings. If it does not open at the first start, BCD tries again at the next start or at Play.
  - **Reconnect** opens a drive again after it was unplugged; **Remove** forgets it.
- **Windows Vulkan (experimental, 64-bit games):** a game's page has **Direct3D › Vulkan (experimental)**. With it, a 64-bit game that draws with Vulkan gets Vulkan through MoltenVK (`vulkan = moltenvk`). Off by default; turn it on per game.
- **Ubisoft Connect, Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4:**
  - Ubisoft Connect no longer stops right after its start.
  - Its built-in browser runs with fewer processes, so it fits.
  - Its installer is not run again for every Ubisoft game once the launcher is installed.
  - A game started through it gets the settings the launcher needs for that session only.
  - Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4 have recommended settings.
- **Foldable iPhone (experimental):** **Settings › Graphics › Foldable iPhone** has two switches, both off by default and both changing nothing on other iPhones and iPads.
  - **Duo enhancements** gives BCD a native interface with Liquid Glass, system tabs and a sidebar, search in the Library and controller navigation. The Windows desktop's Start, Open and Stop sit on Home, and downloads resume when the desktop runs in the background.
  - **Foldable iPhone support** starts a game you add at a resolution shaped like the inner display, and the touch controls follow the screen when you fold or unfold the phone.
  - Installed directly, iOS shows BCD in a small window on the inner display; inside LiveContainer it fills the screen. Both switches apply from the next start of BCD.
- **Colour profiles:** **Settings › Appearance** picks BCD's colours. The default look is unchanged.
- **Xbox 360 controller identity:** **Controls › Controller API › Xbox 360 controller (XInput + device)** on a game's page keeps the XInput pad and also lists it as an Xbox 360 controller, for a game that shows no controller otherwise (Far Cry 4).
- **Aim with a stick:** an aim zone can drive the right stick instead of the mouse (**Aim mode › The finger moves › The right stick** on a game's page), for a game that ignores the mouse while a controller is in use (NieR).

## Fixes and improvements

> **Tried a game on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

Each fix targets the error a log showed; a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

### Games

Every game a log, a report or a test reached since 0.1.634. Where a game is not fixed, its line says which stop it passes now or which stop is named, and where it stops next when a log shows that.

#### Fixed in code

The stop the log showed cannot happen the same way any more. Almost none of these could be tried on a device yet, so a game may now get further and stop at a later point; where a log shows where that is, it is said.

- **1000xRESIST:** the Unity IL2CPP garbage collector raced with the game and ended it after 14 to 15 repairs of the same three virtual calls, about 16 seconds in at 54 FPS (the earlier frame-context experiment did not help). The repair has a fourth pass now that takes the object's class word and proves the table before it writes; and the recommended settings make the collector really suspend the game's threads (as for Megabonk, Big Walk, BALL x PIT and Lonely Mountains). Fixed for that fault; not tested on a device yet.
- **Age of Wonders 4:** the game asked Metal for a multisampled view of a single-sample texture and Metal's validation ended the game. The view now takes the texture's own type. Fixed.
- **Alan Wake:** about 67 Direct3D 9 pipelines per run were refused by the graphics driver, because a vertex shader that writes the point size was used in triangle draws; those draws were missing. The point size is now written only in point draws. Fixed. Text in a sent log's comment also no longer counts as the game's own log lines (it had produced a false "known stop"). For the crash at the end of a run, where BCD itself ended while a game thread exited, two experiments exist for the game's own settings, off by default: `env.MADEIRA_EXIT_POOL_DIAG = 1` names the object and `env.MADEIRA_EXIT_POOL_SKIP = 1` skips that clean-up.
- **Assassin's Creed (2007):** it died after Steam's helper program unloaded and cleared the game's thread-local data. A program's `TlsFree` now clears slots only in its own program's threads, as on Windows (`env.MADEIRA_TLS_CLEAR_OWN_PROCESS = 0` brings the old behaviour back). Fixed.
- **Battlefield 2 and Cold Fear:** the shader converter did not know the compressed-normal vertex formats DEC3N and UDEC3 and stopped the game, Battlefield 2 about 40 seconds in and Cold Fear at its first 3D scene. Both formats are converted now. Fixed. Battlefield 2 with a Direct3D wrapper in its folder can also stop on a stale memory alias; Auto-tune now tries the setting that releases stale memory aliases for it.
- **BioShock:** the game stopped about 110 seconds after the logos, when its renderer thread read a NULL getter right after the first run-time HLSL compiles. Wine's D3DX compile functions never wrote the result variable (`pHResult`) that the game passes; the six functions now write it as Windows documents. This is the likely cause, not proved; if it still stops, the log now holds the compiler's text for every failed compile (24 per process, with the first 160 bytes of the source). The recommended settings keep a file trace of 20,000 lines so the name of the shader-error file shows. For "no sound after the intro", `env.MADEIRA_AUDIO_CAPTURE = 1` (off by default; put it in the game's own settings) offers one silent recording device, never the microphone and never mixed.
- **Black Mesa:** its own crash handler closes the game with exit code 1 after 17 seconds, and the BCD Dock session stayed open on a dead picture. A game that closes within 30 seconds without a picture now ends its session, whatever its exit code. Fixed. The crash itself (a call from Qt's QML engine into an empty page) is not fixed; the log now says whether BCD's views of that page agree.
- **Blur:** the game's protected start-up code uses an x86 bit-scan with a redundant prefix that the emulator rejected ("Invalid instruction"). That form and a few similar ones now decode. Fixed; the stub may stop at its next instruction.
- **Bulletstorm, Hitman: Blood Money, Medal of Honor: Airborne and LEGO Marvel Super Heroes** (BCD Dock): the 32-bit game said Steam was not running (error 113, "Problem starting up Steam") because the Dock wrote Steam's entries only where 64-bit programs read them. They are now also written where a 32-bit game reads them (an entry of a client that is gone is overwritten for the session). Fixed. Bulletstorm's recommended settings also dump the registers at its start-up fault; started directly, Hitman: Blood Money shows "Failed to find Steam", which Auto-tune now answers with "start it with BCD Dock".
- **Capcom games** (Resident Evil 3, Resident Evil 4, Resident Evil Requiem, Monster Hunter Rise, Monster Hunter Stories 3 trial, Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection, Onimusha): their first start ran only Capcom's codec notice, a .NET program that cannot run under Wine Mono and installs nothing, then asked you to restart BCD. BCD now treats that notice as provided, so the first Play starts the game. Fixed. For Mega Man Zero/ZX Legacy Collection and Monster Hunter Rise, whose packed program then stopped in other logs, Auto-tune also tries switching off the emulator's multi-block translation after its earlier attempt.
- **Counter-Strike 2:** the sound broke up in every pass (fixed, see the sound fix below). The Dock start also ended at Steam's "update required" (error 19) without a word: the starting screen and Auto-tune now say that the game needs an update and to install it from its page. A Dock session that never drew a frame is also no longer counted as played, which lets Auto-tune's start rules fire for it.
- **DmC: Devil May Cry:** two logs met the Mono case described below (the check now runs by default). Its other stop, the engine's own `abort()` after 28 seconds with an empty log mirror, is not fixed: its recommended settings now mirror the engine's launch log so the next log names the error.
- **DOOM 3: BFG Edition:** a library entry whose program is `language_setup.exe` (a Qt language chooser that exits 0) looked like a game that closed by itself. The folder scan no longer offers that program, and a setup or language tool that closes within 15 seconds with exit code 0 and no picture now gets a note: "It looks like a setup or language tool, not the game. - **Mono and Unity games** that hung or crashed because a Mono code chunk started in the slack behind a mapped .NET assembly: the check for that case is now on by default (`env.MADEIRA_MZ_VIEW_CHECK = 0` restores the old handling). - **NTE: Neverness to Everness and Dominus Gladiatus:** the emulator's allocation of a 16 MB (and, for Dominus Gladiatus, 8 MB) code-translation buffer failed, and it wrote at address 0x800010 holding a lock that wedged every other thread. Fixed; if its memory is truly full the session usually still ends, now without a wild write.
- **PRAGMATA:** like the other Capcom games above, its first Play ran only Capcom's codec notice and now starts the game. The program then reads a wild pointer in its first second; its recommended settings add the protected-code experiment (registers that only look like shared-page pointers are left alone), which should pass that first second if the guess is right.
- **Prison Architect and Hearts of Iron IV** (and the other Paradox games started through `dowser.exe`): the launcher stub could not find `msiexec`, and its installer failed on a missing `Msi.dll`. When a stream comes up short in nearly every pass for 20 seconds, BCD now asks iOS once per run for a 5 ms audio buffer, as `env.MADEIRA_AUDIO_IO_MS = 5` does; other games are not touched. Fixed. REANIMAL's recommended settings also report capabilities by GPU family, so the game stops using the feature.
- **Red Dead Redemption 2:** Metal aborted on a 64-bit texture atomic on M1 chips (see REANIMAL above), which is fixed. Also new: a notice for a program started from the Windows desktop that has recommended settings (they apply only when it is added as a game with the + button), Auto-tune words for a start without the launcher ("choose the launcher's program"), and for the Launcher's Steam error 113 the replica line named under Grand Theft Auto V.
- **Resident Evil 5 and Portal:** a 32-bit program stored an uninitialised status block over translated code on phones with the small address map and ended with an illegal instruction. - **Roommate (demo) and The Edge Of: Definitive Edition:** a damaged relocation table of the program image sent BCD's loop outside the image: Roommate ended BCD with a bad store, The Edge Of hung for 57 to 76 seconds holding BCD's memory lock. Six more Direct3D 9 words are read as names, and a refused shader's source can be dumped with `env.MADEIRA_HLSL_FAIL_DUMP = 1` (off) if the next wall is another shader. The Shadow of Chernobyl and Call of Pripyat versions share the compiler.

Unreal's media library `mfplay` is missing from the 64-bit set; Auto-tune can add Wine's.
- **Slay the Spire 2:** the game did not start when the translation pool's placement left no room for the 0x140000000 executable window ("BAD POOL placement"); BCD now retries with a pool smaller by 16 MB steps when that window is held. The game's other crash (a .NET code stub across a pool seam) is not fixed: the experiments for it, `env.MADEIRA_SEAM_TRACE = 1` (names the seams) and `env.MADEIRA_ANON_POOL_ADJACENT = 1`, are off by default.

- **Splinter Cell: Conviction:** at a thread's exit the emulator kept a pointer to a destroyed thread state, and a second fault read through it. #### New or changed recommended settings

Use **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended** on a game's page to get its new settings. None of these rows could be tried on a device yet unless it says so, and a game may now get further and stop at a later point.

- **Angry Birds:** Rovio's PC build (32-bit, OpenGL only) said "OpenGL 2.0 renderer not supported" against BCD's no-OpenGL stub and ended after 13 seconds. Its recommended settings now turn on BCD's own OpenGL (Zink). A 32-bit game on a phone with 2.3 GB is the hard case; the other choice is OpenGL ES.
- **Arctic Drive Demo:** the first start failed without Wine's `wintypes.dll`; Auto-tune kept the line that links Wine's `wintypes.dll` and the next start played for 36 minutes, so the recommended settings now carry the line from the first start. That session then ended after one recovered GPU error because iOS killed the app at 99.4 % of its memory limit: Auto-tune now scores it as a memory kill (it had scored it as a hang), and its block-compressed textures (23 % of the limit) make the mip clamp the first attempt. Another log ended when the emulator's pool ran out (UE5, 49 seconds in); the allocation is now refused cleanly instead of written through NULL.
- **Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced:** the 478 MB program does not fit the translation pool, so its recommended settings run it from the loaded image; the loader then stopped on `GameInput.dll`, which the 64-bit set lacked, and BCD now ships Wine's GameInput stub for a game that lists it. What the game does next is not known.
- **Baba Is You:** Wine's Direct3D 9 needs OpenGL, which BCD does not have, and the game's DXVK fallback needs Vulkan, so the game ended after 2 seconds. Its recommended settings give it DXMT's Direct3D 9. If it then asks for something else, Windows Vulkan (**Direct3D › Vulkan (experimental)**) is the next experiment.
- **Battlefield 1942** (and the mods that use its program, such as Desert Combat): Wine's Direct3D 8 found no OpenGL, the game wrote "Failed to init Direct3D" and exited with 0x31. Its recommended settings run Direct3D 8 on Direct3D 9.
- **BlueField:** the Unreal Engine 5 fan game's shipping program imports `tbs.dll`, which the 64-bit set lacks; its recommended settings add Wine's `tbs` as an opt-in DLL. What it does after its imports is not known.
- **Brotato:** the Godot game reads its controllers once at its start, and the touch pad or a paired pad connects 17 to 46 seconds later, so it never saw one. Its recommended settings connect player 1 from the session start and use BCD's OpenGL (Zink).
- **Buckshot Roulette:** the Godot game (OpenGL only) ended at BCD's no-OpenGL stub; its recommended settings now give it BCD's OpenGL (Zink) at the first start instead of after a failed one.
- **Burnout Paradise: The Ultimate Box:** the first Play ran only the DirectX setup (`DXSETUP.exe`, exit -9) and used up the start; the next start played. BCD ships what that setup installs, so the recommended settings skip it. The game also reads its pads once at its start, so player 1 is connected from the session start.
- **Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare:** the allocator asks for one 69 GiB reservation, does not check the answer and writes at 0x100000000; the largest hole BCD's map has is 32 GiB. Its recommended settings serve such a reservation in part: a real 16 GiB at the start, the rest reported but not mapped. A commit past the real part prints `[oversize] ... commit ... failed`.
- **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4:** the program needs AVX (Auto-tune kept it) and loads a DLL that imports `tbs.dll`; its recommended settings add Wine's `tbs`. If the game then asks for a TPM, that is its own requirement and no setting changes it.
- **Call of Duty: World at War:** after returning from the background, GPU work was refused ("Insufficient Permission") and the picture froze for 7 to 14 seconds.
