THPS2 now has a direct CRT ON/OFF button during iPhone gameplay, black top/bottom letterbox bars on iOS and Windows, and a renderer adjustment to keep flat HUD overlays in the central 4:3 area. The iOS CPU interpreter also has a faster RAM instruction-fetch path. Slam ’n Jam widescreen projection now runs before guest clipping and preserves native sprite/text rendering. SSF2T extends finite scenery edges with mirrored backgrounds while preserving sprite priority. UMK3 extends mixed background tile bands with safeguards for unrelated props. ### Downloads - Four unsigned iOS IPAs: sign and install using ESign. - Windows x64 ZIP: contains all four games and required SDL libraries. - SHA256SUMS.txt: checksums for the downloadable builds. Existing bundle identifiers are preserved. Game files are not included. NBA Showtime remains unfinished and is not included. ### Validation and remaining checks All four iOS and Windows builds passed. Controller, VRAM, GTE projection and stage-edge regression checks passed; 92 Dreamcast shader variants compiled and linked. A local Slam ’n Jam gameplay capture showed complete crowd rendering in one tested camera. THPS2 iPhone frame-rate improvement and HUD placement still need device confirmation. Slam ’n Jam shot-clock readability and other cameras, plus affected SSF2T and UMK3 stages, still need gameplay retesting. Native PS1 resolution is unchanged. SSF2T edge scenery uses reflected existing artwork.

v1.3 makes games run steadier, adds a single report file for bugs and crashes, and fixes several crashes when a game starts or stops. ## Highlights - **EspressU report:** one file, Documents/Logs/EspressU-Report.txt, with your device, iOS version, memory, all settings, the full log, crashes with backtraces and a performance summary for every game (average fps, 1% and 0.1% lows, stutters, what limited the game, temperature). Share or delete it in Settings › Device report and logs. - **Fewer crashes:** starting a game no longer crashes when the saved pipeline archive cannot be opened, and low memory while loading no longer gets the app killed as easily. - **Steadier games:** the JIT no longer compiles the same code twice, which leaves more CPU for the game. ## Performance - New experimental options in Settings › Performance › Experimental. All of them are off by default: - Free memory on warnings: frees textures and idle GPU memory when iOS asks for memory back. - No duplicate JIT work: JIT threads stop compiling the same function at the same time. - Faster interpreter without JIT: cached code blocks are linked. - MetalFX upscaling: sharper enlarging of the picture. Costs some GPU time. - GamePad pacing and a lower-resolution GamePad screen, so the GamePad does not slow the TV image. - Metal 4 output (iOS 26): not recommended yet. In tests it was not faster, sometimes slower, so it needs more work. - GPU memory failure history and a Tuning log that show what each option did. - Pipeline compiles slow down when memory is low, so loading a big game on a device with little free memory no longer kills the app. - A texture that cannot be allocated now gets a small stand-in with the same format instead of breaking later draws. ## Stability - Fixed the crash when opening the Metal binary archive on game start. If it crashes once, the archive is switched off for that game, and games still start fast because the system keeps its own cache. - Fixed crashes when leaving a game and when starting the next one. ## Logging - All logs are in Documents/Logs. - Every session and every game start is appended to the same report until you delete it. The top of each session says how the one before it ended: normally, with a crash, or killed by iOS. ## Install 1. Download the unsigned `EspressU-1.3.ipa` below. 2. Install it with SideInstaller and turn on the increased memory limit. Without it, most games run out of memory. 3. For JIT, import your pairing file in Settings › JIT and connect LocalDevVPN. Note: v1.3 uses a new app identifier (dev.espressu.EspressU). It installs next to v1.2 as a separate app, so your games, saves and settings from v1.2 are not carried over. Back up your saves from v1.2 first. EspressU contains no firmware, keys or games. Use your own dumps from your own Wii U.

v1.2 makes games load faster, fixes crashes on game start, lets you remap your controller and reworks the on-screen controls. ## Highlights - **Faster loading:** compiled shaders are kept between launches, so a game starts much quicker the second time. - **Fewer crashes:** game start no longer crashes when memory is tight or when JIT takes a moment to connect. - **Controller remapping:** Settings › Controls › Controller buttons. Pick a GamePad button, press the one on your controller that should drive it. Touch controls keep their layout. - **All touch options in the game:** open HOME › Move controls for size, opacity, stick spacing, shoulder height, haptics, deadzone and hiding the controls when a controller is connected. ## Performance - Faster Metal renderer with fewer per-draw costs. - The shader cache is saved as soon as you leave the app. - New settings: Favour accuracy, Favour performance and One-core mode, globally and per game. ## Stability and JIT - If JIT cannot start, the game runs with the slower interpreter instead of crashing. - The recompiler survives low memory. - Quitting a game no longer freezes the app. - LocalDevVPN is checked live: JIT turns grey when the VPN is off and comes back by itself. - Built-in pairing needs iOS 27. On older versions you can import a pairing file. ## Controls - The on-screen controls hide at once when a controller connects (if you turn that on), and come back when it disconnects. - Sticks are always round. - New HOME symbol, and a blow button next to the FPS display for games that ask you to blow into the mic. - The in-game buttons fade out after a few seconds (on by default on iPhone, off on iPad). Tap or swipe down at the top edge to bring them back. - The iPhone game list and settings work with a controller. ## Game page and menus - New game page with collapsible groups. Save export/import and shader cache import are there, and graphic packs have their own page. - New Add menu that works with a controller. - Graphic pack downloads no longer get stuck at 100%. - Open-source licences now list MuffinEMU, which EspressU is based on. ## Install 1. Download the unsigned `EspressU-1.2.ipa` below. 2. Install it with SideInstaller (or SideStore/AltStore) and turn on the increased memory limit. Without it, most games run out of memory. 3. For JIT, import your pairing file in Settings › JIT and connect LocalDevVPN. Updating from v1.1 keeps your games, saves and settings. EspressU contains no firmware, keys or games. Use your own dumps from your own Wii U.

# EspressU v1.1 A big update for iPhone, plus second-screen support and fixes. ## iPhone - New game library: two-column grid with a "Continue playing" card for your last game. Long-press a game for favourite and options. - Pull down to search. The keyboard opens right away; Cancel or a tap elsewhere closes it. - The in-game top bar hides itself. Swipe down from the top edge to bring it back. - Settings are a compact list that fits a phone screen. - iPad keeps its current layout. ## Second screen - External display support is on by default. The TV screen goes to the external display and your device works as the Wii U GamePad. - Pause and the FPS counter stay on your device. - On older iOS versions, AirPlay may still only mirror your screen. ## Fixes and improvements - Graphic pack options no longer close the game settings menu. - Vulkan: fewer GPU errors on Apple GPUs and no memory spikes when scenes load. - Fixed a crash when starting a game without JIT. - Zone is now the default control style for new players. - Better logging when the built-in JIT check fails. - GitHub links updated, Discord link added (Settings > About). Based on MuffinEMU by Void ## What's Changed * Vulkan on iOS: fix GPU page faults and a memory spike (from MuffinEMU 10.1 and 10.2) by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/2 * About screen: credit MuffinEMU in the app by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/4 * Make Zone the default control style for new players by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/5 * Fix the crash when launching a game without JIT (SIGTRAP in BreakGetJITMapping) by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/6 * Log the reason when the built-in JIT preflight fails by @MuffinEMU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/7 * Improve iPhone UI, add AirPlay GamePad mode, fix graphic pack settings by @EspressU in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/8 ## New Contributors * @MuffinEMU made their first contribution in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/2 * @EspressU made their first contribution in https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/pull/8 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EspressU/EspressU-Emu/compare/v1.0...v1.1
Based on MuffinEMU by Void

NBA Showtime now uses the arcade/MAME edition on iOS and Windows, replacing the previous PlayStation edition. Import your own nbashowt.zip and matching nbashowt.chd; game data is not included. Showtime iPhone changes: - Move emulation off the UI thread and pace it using a monotonic deadline. - Batch two signature-checked MIPS polling/copy loops while preserving guest cycles, RAM semantics and interrupt boundaries. - Bound queued audio latency; fade starvation/recovery and transition across dropped audio to reduce crackles. - Reduce CRT drawable workload under thermal pressure. CRT remains on by default and can be toggled. Includes all pending source changes for the other four ports, including their rendering, camera, CRT and version-resource updates. Downloads: - SSF2T 0.4.2, UMK3 0.4.2, Slam n Jam 96 0.4.2, THPS2 0.4.3, NBA Showtime 0.4.6 unsigned iOS IPAs. - NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip contains all five Windows builds and required DLLs. - SHA256SUMS.txt provides download checksums. IPAs require signing before installation. Validation: iOS and Windows builds passed; 15,000 randomized MIPS-loop comparisons passed with sanitizers; audio, worker-thread, game import, rendering and camera regression tests passed. The latest separate Showtime iPhone test build was reported to run well by the device owner. Sustained coverage of every scene and physical four-player testing remain pending. Showtime arcade widescreen projection is not implemented; native arcade proportions are retained.

NBA Showtime (PlayStation USA) joins the four existing ports. All five iOS apps and Windows executables are version 0.3.0. Changes: - SSF2T: fixed 512-column widescreen output prevents camera-dependent resizing. Unsupported stage edges are clipped inside the fixed canvas and filled with colored margins; scenery is not mirrored. - Slam 'n Jam '96: extend the SLES-00076 game's crowd/court clipping checks, rather than only widening the GPU canvas. Original interior pixels and HUD are preserved. No coin prompts; Restart Game remains the console action. - UMK3: extend solid background/gradient clears into the extra columns before drawing foreground scenery, fixing the rectangular gap reproduced in Scorpion's Lair. - THPS2: keep the gameplay HUD in the centered original 4:3 area. Increase the normal follow-camera offset by 25% through a guarded boot-time instruction patch, verified on the USA executable. Black letterbox bars and CRT toggle are retained. - NBA Showtime: supplied PlayStation USA BIN support, four-player multitap, Hangtime-style controls/UI, centered HUD and expanded gameplay canvas, CRT enabled by default with on/off controls. - Include THPS2's Windows C++ runtime DLLs and version all five builds consistently. Downloads: - NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip: all five Windows games. Extract it and keep every DLL beside its EXE. - Five unsigned IPAs: sign with your sideloading tool. Keep existing bundle identifiers to preserve app data. - SHA256SUMS.txt: checksums for the downloadable builds. Game files and signing credentials are not included. NBA Showtime needs the extracted raw PlayStation MODE2/2352 BIN named nbashowt.bin, not its archive or an arcade ROM. Validation: all ten platform builds passed; Apple/SDL virtual-controller tests, shader compilation, texture-cache checks, rendering helper regressions and local gameplay captures passed. Local captures covered SSF2T camera limits, Slam court pans, UMK3 Scorpion's Lair, THPS2 Hangar, and NBA Showtime gameplay/toggle/HUD. This is not complete stage coverage or physical iPhone/Windows multiplayer validation. THPS2 iOS still uses the CPU interpreter; this release does not claim a verified frame-rate improvement. Some Slam camera angles can still reveal the finite arena's dark exterior.

SSF2T and Slam n Jam 0.2.2 iOS and Windows builds passed. iOS IPAs are unsigned; sign/install with ESign, keeping the existing bundle identifiers. Slam n Jam: startup asks for keyboard 1 or controller Start, with no coin prompt. Restart reads RESTART GAME. PS1 Select is available as Select (keyboard Tab, controller View); old settings migrate. Native gameplay canvas expands from 320 to 426 columns instead of stretching. Original-size sprites, text and HUD remain centered; textures live in original VRAM and expanded framebuffers use separate banks. CRT behavior is unchanged. SSF2T: reflected edge artwork removed. The visible gameplay window narrows symmetrically as the camera approaches finite stage boundaries, returning to the original 384 columns at either limit. It expands away from those limits. Menus keep their original proportions centered in a 512-column frame with colored sides. Validation: iOS and Windows builds, controller suite, canvas isolation and stage-boundary tests passed. Real Slam gameplay toggled 320 -> 426 -> 320 columns; all 81,920 pixels of the central original view matched the same saved frame exactly. Real SSF2T gameplay captures returned to 384 columns at both edges, and menu captures were 512 columns with colored margins. Device-specific iPhone and Windows gameplay still needs retesting. No game files or game screenshots are included. SSF2T and Slam n Jam are version 0.2.2. The unchanged THPS2 and UMK3 version 0.2.1 builds are also included here. Download NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip for all four current Windows builds; the smaller SSF2T-SlamJam96 ZIP contains only those two games. BUILD-VERSIONS.txt inside the complete ZIP identifies every game version.

THPS2 now has a direct CRT ON/OFF button during iPhone gameplay, black top/bottom letterbox bars on iOS and Windows, and a renderer adjustment to keep flat HUD overlays in the central 4:3 area. The iOS CPU interpreter also has a faster RAM instruction-fetch path. Slam ’n Jam widescreen projection now runs before guest clipping and preserves native sprite/text rendering. SSF2T extends finite scenery edges with mirrored backgrounds while preserving sprite priority. UMK3 extends mixed background tile bands with safeguards for unrelated props. ### Downloads - Four unsigned iOS IPAs: sign and install using ESign. - Windows x64 ZIP: contains all four games and required SDL libraries. - SHA256SUMS.txt: checksums for the downloadable builds. Existing bundle identifiers are preserved. Game files are not included. NBA Showtime remains unfinished and is not included. ### Validation and remaining checks All four iOS and Windows builds passed. Controller, VRAM, GTE projection and stage-edge regression checks passed; 92 Dreamcast shader variants compiled and linked. A local Slam ’n Jam gameplay capture showed complete crowd rendering in one tested camera. THPS2 iPhone frame-rate improvement and HUD placement still need device confirmation. Slam ’n Jam shot-clock readability and other cameras, plus affected SSF2T and UMK3 stages, still need gameplay retesting. Native PS1 resolution is unchanged. SSF2T edge scenery uses reflected existing artwork.

NativePorts 0.2.0 includes Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3, Slam ’n Jam ’96 and Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 2 for iOS and Windows. - Uses the supplied game artwork for each iOS app and Windows executable/window icon. Keeps unique bundle IDs unchanged to preserve installed game data. - Adds game-specific widescreen patches for SSF2T, UMK3 and Slam ’n Jam ’96, alongside the existing Flycast widescreen patch for THPS2. Widescreen can be toggled in display settings. - Updates aspect-ratio handling and NewPixie CRT rendering to preserve picture edges. CRT filtering remains enabled by default and can be disabled. - Refreshes cached core sources before builds so source changes rebuild the embedded engine. - Includes touch controls and remappable multiplayer controller support on both platforms. Download one unsigned IPA per game and sign it with your sideloading tool. For Windows, extract NativePorts-Windows-x64.zip and keep each EXE beside its SDL2.dll. Use your own game files; ROMs, disc images and signing credentials are not included. Known limitations: THPS2 on iOS uses an interpreter and may run below full speed. Slam ’n Jam ’96 can leave dark corners in some widescreen camera angles. NBA Showtime remains frontend-only and is not included. Validation: all four iOS build logs report success; Windows binaries were packaged from the latest local builds. Virtual controller tests passed for all five frontends, along with ROM-import checks, basketball action tests and both THPS2 texture-cache configurations. These checks do not establish full-speed performance or physical multiplayer operation on every device. SHA256SUMS.txt contains asset checksums.

Super Street Fighter II Turbo 0.1.1, Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 0.1.1, Slam 'n Jam '96 0.1.1 and Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2 0.1.9 for iOS and Windows. Unsigned IPAs for sideloading (ESign, AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly) and a Windows x64 package. No game files are included; see the README for what you need.

versions.localizedDescription: Android and iOS mobile builds of Mega Man 64: Recompiled. - Editable gameplay and menu touch pads: movement stick, N64 buttons, position/size/opacity/color controls, and GAME PAD / MENU PAD switching. - SDL USB/Bluetooth controller support and configurable bindings. - Mobile renderer fixes, Android Vulkan surface/descriptor handling, and iOS screenshot/notification size restoration. - Persistent USA FlashRAM saves, atomic replacement, backup writes, and background save flushing. - The supplied Mega Man 64 artwork is now the app icon on both platforms. - Both application IDs are `com.devz.megaman64`, matching the other ports' naming convention. **Downloads:** install the ARM64 APK on Android 8.0+ with a compatible Vulkan GPU. Sign the ARM64 IPA for your own iOS 16+ device using eSign or another signing tool. The IPA contains no personal certificate or provisioning profile. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers both downloads. **ROM:** supply your own Mega Man 64 USA ROM through the launcher. `.z64`, `.v64`, and `.n64` byte orders are accepted. Japanese Rockman DASH gameplay is not supported by this USA recompilation; the loader reports that limitation. No ROM or save data is bundled. **Existing saves:** the new IDs create separate app storage. Back up the old app's `config/saves` folder before changing builds, preserve filenames, and keep the old app installed until the backup is safe. Storage locations and restoration limits are described in MOBILE.md. Saves are not automatically migrated between different IDs. The repository starts with a clean source history and pinned dependencies. It excludes ROM-derived generated sources, ROMs, saves, logs, SDKs, local build folders, personal paths, and signing keys. Required build scripts, application assets, licenses, and upstream attribution remain available. Validation: source privacy and whitespace checks; dependency patches applied against pinned revisions; APK signature and 16 KB alignment; ARM64 package structure; ROM/private-path scans; icon pixel checks, application IDs, Android Java class and all renamed JNI entry points. Rendering/gameplay had been confirmed on iOS and Adreno 710 Android before these icon/ID/publication changes. Installation of this newly packaged release still needs verification on devices. Upstream: https://github.com/MegaMan64Recomp/MegaMan64Recompiled

versions.localizedDescription: ### New - **Mouse sensitivity (Controls → Edit touch layout).** A Sensitivity slider sets how fast the on-screen cursor moves when you drag in PAD mode. - **Saved touch layouts.** The touch editor has a **Saved** menu: save the current layout under a name, load one, replace it with the current layout, or delete it. - **Aim stick attack.** Choose what the aim stick does: **Off**, **Release** (one attack in the aimed direction when you let go) or **Auto** (attacks over and over while the stick is pushed, using whatever you have equipped). - **Two-finger zoom switch (Settings → Controls).** Turns the two-finger scroll that zooms the game on or off. - **ZombieBuddy switch (Developer Tools → Tools).** Starts the game with `-javaagent:ZombieBuddy.jar` for mods that need ZombieBuddy. Put `ZombieBuddy.jar` in the game folder (Files, pziOS, game); if the file is missing the switch is skipped. - **Zink graphics backend (experimental, Developer Tools → Tools).** An optional second graphics path: **Graphics Backend: Zink (Experimental)** runs the game on Mesa's Zink (OpenGL 4.5 on Vulkan) over MoltenVK (Vulkan on Metal) instead of the normal gl4es + MetalANGLE layer. It exists for mods that need desktop OpenGL 4.5, for example **Viewpoint** (a 3D renderer mod, needs ZombieBuddy), uses more memory, and is off by default. Next to it: **Zink Detailed Log** (writes frame timing, draw and pipeline counts and the graphics limits of your device to `jvm.log` every few seconds) and **Zink Probe** (checks which OpenGL 4.5 features your device supports and saves a short report as `zink-probe.txt` in the pziOS folder). **If you try Zink, please turn on Zink Detailed Log and send your `jvm.log` (and `zink-probe.txt`) together with your device and iOS version; that data is what we need to make it faster.** - **iOS 17 and 18 Support.** On iOS 26 and later pziOS gets its executable memory from the debugger as a mirror-mapped region. On iOS 17 and 18, pziOS now uses the JVM's classic code-cache path instead, chosen automatically and logged as `settings: JIT path classic` in `jvm.log`. Please report results on iOS 17 and 18 with your `jvm.log`. ## Use the included 'pzios-jam.js' in StikDebug to configure manual JIT. ### Join Us In https://discord.gg/7fNEVQpkaA

### New - **Virtual Gamepad (Controls tab).** The on-screen controls can act as a game controller (two sticks, A/B/X/Y, D-pad, bumpers, triggers, Back/Start). - **Increased Memory** Holds the game's Java memory in helper processes, so iOS does not count it against the app's own limit (the app's memory then shows lower; the device's real RAM is still the limit). It uses private iOS features, needs the app's extensions (it does not work inside container apps such as LiveContainer) and may stop working after an iOS update. ### Fixed - **The game crashed at the main menu on a fresh install.** The game's preview videos need a video library pziOS does not ship; pziOS now keeps the game's "video effects" option off. ### Improved - **Clearer JIT helper errors.** If the built-in JIT helper cannot start, the message now says what to check and shows an error number. The first lines of `jvm.log` now show the app's bundle ID, version, JIT method and helper ID, which makes problem reports much easier to read. ### We're Actively Looking For Beta Testers Join Us In https://discord.gg/7fNEVQpkaA

versions.localizedDescription: Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install ## 改进 - **iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时会提示读数可能只有一半。** 在 iPhone 18 Pro 系列上用有线充电、协商功率超过 30 W 时，表盘旁会显示"可能只读到一半"，功率页和适配器页也会说明原因：这种情况下输入和电芯两侧的传感器都可能只测到一半功率。数值本身不做修正。 - **新增"电量核对"。** 充电时，App 会把电量上升的速度换算成功率，和电芯传感器在同一段时间里测到的功率对比。如果电量涨得明显比传感器测到的快（1.6 倍以上），表盘旁会显示"读数偏低"，并给出两边的数值；如果两边一致，会显示核对通过，上面那条"可能只读到一半"的提示也会隐藏。电量要上涨至少 3% 才能给出结果，通常需要几分钟。 - **传感器按 SMC key 识别，重复的读数会合并。** iOS 27 上每个传感器都会出现两份，以前只取第一份，现在取两份的平均值；发热页的列表里每个传感器也只出现一次。发热页和原始数据会在传感器名旁边标出 key（比如电池温度偏高的那个是 `TG0B`）。 - **电池能量按机型给默认值。** iPhone 18 Pro Max 为 21.75 Wh，iPhone 17 Pro Max 为 19.7 Wh，其他机型仍是 15 Wh。设置 → 电池能量 里会显示本机型的额定值，点"使用"即可填入。已经手动设置过的值保持不变。 - **原始数据新增"Derived power checks"一节。** 这一节记录半功率提示是否生效，以及电量核对的结果。 ## 修复 - 适配器：iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时，读数偏低不再被误判成线材或接口的问题；在无法确认读数完整时，不计算线路电阻和电流利用率。 ## 注意 - iPhone 18 Pro 高功率充电时，完整的输入功率仍然读不到：另一路充电电流没有可读的传感器。这个版本只能提示和核对，不能补上缺失的功率；这段时间的充电记录里的能量统计也仍然偏低。 - "电量核对"还没有在 iPhone 18 Pro 上验证过。如果你有这台手机，请在 45 W 充电、电量上涨几个百分点之后，从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。 - 如果你的机型不在上面的列表里，请在 设置 → 电池能量 里填入正确的数值，否则电量核对可能一直给不出结论。 - 部分发现来自 ChargeSpeed 作者在 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上的实测。 --- ## Improvements - **The iPhone 18 Pro now warns when a reading may be half.** On an iPhone 18 Pro model charging by cable on a profile above 30 W, the dial shows "may read half", and the Power and Adapter pages explain why: in that mode both the input and the cell sensors can see only half the power. The numbers themselves are not corrected. - **New battery level check.** While charging, the app turns the battery level's rise into watts and compares it with what the cell sensors measured over the same stretch. If the level rises much faster (1.6× or more), the dial shows "reading low" with both figures; if they agree, the check says so and the "may read half" warning is hidden. It needs at least a 3% rise, usually a few minutes. - **Sensors are identified by SMC key, and duplicate copies are merged.** iOS 27 publishes every sensor twice. The app used to take the first copy; it now averages the two, and each sensor appears once on the Thermal page. The Thermal page and Raw data show the key beside the name (the battery sensor that runs hot is `TG0B`). - **Battery energy defaults by model.** 21.75 Wh for the iPhone 18 Pro Max, 19.7 Wh for the iPhone 17 Pro Max, 15 Wh otherwise. Settings → Battery energy shows your model's rating with a "Use" button. A value you set yourself is kept. - **Raw data gains a "Derived power checks" section**, recording whether the half-reading warning applies and the battery level check's result. ## Fixes - Adapter: on an iPhone 18 Pro at high power, a low reading is no longer blamed on the cable or plugs; path resistance and current utilisation are not worked out while the reading may be incomplete. ## Notes - On an iPhone 18 Pro at high power the full input still cannot be read: the second charging path has no readable sensor. This version can warn and cross-check, not fill in the missing power, and energy totals recorded during that time are still low. - The battery level check has not been verified on an iPhone 18 Pro. If you have one, charge at 45 W, let the level rise a few percent, then copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it. - If your model is not in the list above, set Settings → Battery energy to its rating, or the level check may never reach a verdict. - Some of these findings come from measurements by ChargeSpeed's author on an iPhone 18 Pro Max. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.5.1...v1.6.0

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install ## 改进 - **输入读数不完整时，不再当作输入功率显示。** 在 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，输入传感器只测到了一部分功率（比如实际 43.5 W 只显示 21.8 W）。现在当进入电芯的功率比输入读数还大时，表盘改为显示"进入电池"的功率，不再计算效率和适配器利用率，并在功率页和适配器页说明原因。 - **电池温度改用中位数。** 部分机型有四个同名的电池温度传感器，其中一个明显偏高。"电池"读数、热力图上的电池标记和分区标题现在都用中位数，四个读数仍然逐个列出。 - **异常温度不再参与计算。** 以下读数不再计入热力图和最高温度，但仍保留在"原始数据"里，并注明原因：低于 −10 °C 的 PMU 传感器、高于 85 °C 而结温对不上的充电芯片温度、恰好为 0.0 °C 的传感器。 - **支持 iPad。** 支持横竖屏，内容不再横向拉满。iPad 的传感器对应关系还没有验证，数据仅供参考。 - **文案更准确。** "来自充电器"改为"手机接口处 / 充电线圈处"；适配器页注明额定功率是协商出的上限，不是功率计读数。 - **原始数据更便于反馈。** 每个传感器带上服务编号，并列出被排除的读数。 ## 修复 - 适配器：供电规格列表里不再出现"65.5 V × 65.53 A"这样的无效档位。 - 实时活动：App 在前台时，读数变化 0.05 就会更新，不再等到变化 0.2 W 或 0.5 °C。 ## 注意 - 这些修复是根据用户反馈的数据做的，没有在对应机型的真机上验证过。如果你的机型上读数仍然不对，请在 设置 → 原始数据 里复制导出并反馈。 - iPhone 18 Pro Max 高功率充电时的完整输入功率仍然读不到，需要该机型在 45 W 状态下的原始数据导出。 - App 退到后台后，灵动岛上的读数会停住，这是系统限制；想持续看实时读数请使用悬浮表。 --- ## Improvements - **An incomplete input reading is no longer shown as the input.** On an iPad Pro and an iPhone 18 Pro Max the input sensors see only part of the power (21.8 W shown for a real 43.5 W, for one). When more power is reaching the cell than the input reading accounts for, the dial now shows the "into battery" figure, efficiency and adapter utilisation are not worked out, and the Power and Adapter pages say why. - **Battery temperature is a median.** Some models have four battery temperature sensors under one name, one of them reading clearly high. The Battery readout, the heat map's battery pin and the zone header all use the median now; all four are still listed. - **Impossible temperatures are left out.** These no longer reach the heat map or the hottest reading, and stay in Raw data with a reason: a PMU sensor below −10 °C, a charge-IC temperature above 85 °C that its junction sensor does not back up, and a sensor at exactly 0.0 °C. - **iPad support.** All orientations, and content no longer stretches edge to edge. The sensor mapping on iPad is unverified, so treat its numbers with care. - **More accurate wording.** "From charger" is now "At phone port" / "At charging coil", and the Adapter page says the rating is a negotiated ceiling, not a wall-meter reading. - **Raw data is easier to report from.** Every sensor carries its service index, and excluded readings are listed. ## Fixes - Adapter: the profile list no longer shows an invalid "65.5 V × 65.53 A" entry. - Live Activity: with the app in front, it updates on a 0.05 change instead of waiting for 0.2 W or 0.5 °C. ## Notes - These fixes were made from data users reported and were not verified on those devices. If readings still look wrong on your model, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it. - On an iPhone 18 Pro Max the full input power at high-power charging still cannot be read; a Raw data dump taken at 45 W on that model is needed. - Once the app is in the background the Dynamic Island reading stops. That is a system limit; use the floating meter for a live reading. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing. https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install ## 改进 - **缺失的读数不再显示成 0。** 某一侧没有读数时（例如无线充电没有输入电流），图表在那一段断开，不再掉到 0；能量统计也只累计真正测到的时间段。 - **充电效率更准。** "电芯占比"和"负载与损耗"只按输入侧、电池侧同时有读数的时间段计算，某一侧中途缺失不会再把结果带偏。 - **两个标签改名。** "以热量损失"改为"负载与损耗"：这部分是手机自身耗电加上转换损耗，并不全是发热。"效率 / 往返效率"改为"电芯占比"。 - **"暂停充电"的判断更稳。** 状态切换要持续 30 秒才生效，不再来回跳；没有电池电流读数时显示"保持状态未知"，不再直接当成暂停充电。 - **耗电估算不再因为切到后台而清空。** 短暂离开 App 再回来，估算值还在。 - **历史文件损坏时不再被直接覆盖。** 读不出来的历史文件会改名保留，并在"原始数据"页给出提示。 - **发热相关的说明更准确。** 系统热状态只说明"可能"在限制充电电流，不再说成确定的原因。 ## 修复 - 历史记录：没有测到输入侧的记录，"输入"和"充电器峰值"显示为"—"，不再显示 0；列表里的迷你曲线改画电池侧功率，不再空白。 - 实时活动：灵动岛展开后，右上角的状态文字和"结束"按钮不再被圆角裁掉；暂停提示能完整显示。 - 原始数据：重名的 HID 服务各占一行，不再被合并。 ## 注意 - 升级后历史记录的格式有变化，旧版本读不了新格式。**如果从 1.5.0 降级回旧版本，历史记录会丢失。** --- ## Improvements - **A missing reading is no longer shown as 0.** When a rail has no reading (wireless charging has no input current, for one), the charts break there instead of dropping to zero, and energy is only counted over time that was actually measured. - **Charge efficiency is more accurate.** "Cell share" and "Load + loss" are computed only over the time both the input and the battery side were read, so one side dropping out no longer skews them. - **Two labels renamed.** "Lost as heat" is now "Load + loss": it is the phone's own consumption plus conversion loss, not all heat. "Efficiency" / "Round trip" is now "Cell share". - **"Charging on hold" is steadier.** A change has to last 30 seconds before it shows, so it no longer flickers; with no battery-current reading at all it says "hold status unknown" instead of assuming a hold. - **The discharge estimate survives a short trip to the background** instead of being cleared every time. - **An unreadable history file is no longer overwritten.** It is renamed and kept, and Raw data says so. - **Thermal wording is more careful.** The system thermal state says charging *may* be limited; it is no longer stated as the cause. ## Fixes - History: a session whose input side was never measured shows "—" for Delivered and the charger's peak instead of 0, and its row draws the battery curve instead of nothing. - Live Activity: the expanded Dynamic Island no longer clips its status text and End button, and the paused message fits. - Raw data: HID services that share a name are listed as separate rows. ## Note - The history file format changed and older versions cannot read it. **Downgrading from 1.5.0 loses the session history.** **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0

Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

apps.localizedDescription: Apollo is an app for Reddit built for customizability, smoothness, gestures, and taking advantage of everything iOS has to offer. Apollo is a beautiful Reddit app built for fast navigation with an incredibly powerful set of features. Thanks to features like the Jump Bar, fully customizable gestures, and a super-charged Media Viewer, browsing Reddit has never been this amazing. It's created specifically with iOS design guidelines in mind, so it fits right at home on your device, and with input from thousands of Redditors helping sculpt and perfect it over several years before launching: • Jump Bar, for super-fast hopping between subreddits • Super-charged Media Viewer for an amazing experience viewing images, GIFs, videos, albums, and more from a variety of sources. • Tabbed interface for easy navigating • Incredibly powerful Markdown composer for writing comments and posts • Full inline Imgur uploading, both images and albums • Large or compact posts depending on your preference • Dark mode (can be automatic) • Fully customizable gestures • Safari View Controller for browsing articles and links • Inline previews of media in comments • 3D Touch support • Beautifully organized Inbox • Filtering and blocking • Face ID / Touch ID / Passcode lock • Moderator features • Tons of settings to tweak • GIF scrubbing to go backward and forward in time • Multiple accounts • Powerful search • Full Markdown rendering • Unobtrusive Volume Indicator As well as much, much more and it's constantly evolving. If you have anything you'd specifically like to see, come to the ApolloApp subreddit and we'd love to hear it! Apollo is an unofficial app, and side effects may include an incredible browsing experience.

Apollo-Reborn also runs its own website and sources at https://apolloreborn.app --- ### Performance - Send fewer Reddit requests on **API-Key-Free** accounts by not repeating link preview lookups for sites that block previews and by briefly reusing the Inbox's reply lookups, so ordinary reading reaches Reddit's rate limit later (#1579: @icpryde) - New replies, and anything you post or edit, still refresh right away ### Fixes - Fix **multi-photo posts** showing a reddit.com link and 0 photos since Reddit began marking their photos as failed, so the gallery, feed carousel, media viewer, Save All and Gallery View show them again (#1589: @icpryde) - Covers galleries posted from Apollo with Reddit as the Media Upload Host and from other apps; they show as square cards in the feed - Fix **API-Key-Free search** showing "Error searching" or "Error loading subreddits" for post search, searching within a subreddit or multireddit, and subreddit search (#1557: @DeltAndy123) - Fix **All Posts (r/all)** showing "Couldn't load posts" on **API-Key-Free** accounts, for every sort and with Exclude Subscriptions (#1570: @icpryde) - All Posts has another way in before Old Reddit, and if Reddit blocks another **API-Key-Free** read, a route update can work around it without an app update (#1594: @DeltAndy123) - Open the feed you chose to start on again at launch by turning **Restore Reading Session** off by default; it moves to Posts & Feeds → Feed (#1511: @IllIIllIllIllII) - A choice you changed yourself in 4.0.0 is kept, so turn it back on there if you relied on the 4.0.0 default - Fix a crash when opening a **post or comment link** while Reddit is rate-limiting requests, most often right after returning to Apollo; the usual "Error loading comments" banner shows instead (#1572: @icpryde) - Fix the **home screen icon** turning into iOS's generic grid after installing or updating Apollo with an alternate icon selected (#1554: @icpryde) - Apollo re-applies your icon once on the first launch after the update, so iOS shows its "You have changed the icon" alert; tapping the selected icon again under App Icon also redraws it - Open a tapped **Inbox reply** or comment link directly on that comment, without the post flashing, gliding and snapping into place, and keep your place when returning from a pushed page (#1584: @icpryde) - Show the **Unrecoverable** label on deleted comments the archive can't restore, instead of a thin, cut-off red strip with only the age showing (#1578: @icpryde) - Load **Live Interactive Posts** for accounts set to old Reddit, instead of spinning on "Loading interactive post…", and make the ✕ and ••• buttons work in an interactive post's expanded view (#1553: @icpryde) - Report from the ••• menu opens and closes properly, and feed cards return to their compact size after closing - Keep **sign-in**, **Badge Book** trophies and **API-Key-Free** backup reads working for accounts Old Reddit turns away (#1553: @icpryde) - The API-Key-Free sign-in sheet no longer offers Switch to Old Reddit - Open a just-posted **video post** with its video playing from the "Posted! Tap to view." banner, instead of a still image (#1413: @icpryde) - The banner now waits until Reddit finishes processing the video, so it can appear a few seconds later; applies to videos uploaded with **Media Upload Host** set to Reddit - Stop the **media post composer** jumping when you pick a flair or photo with a title that wraps onto two or more lines (#1571: @icpryde) - Open the **subreddit switcher** with the keyboard down, so your favorites stay visible until you tap the search field (#1564: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Stop the rows Apollo Reborn adds to the classic (non-Liquid Glass) post **••• menu** turning gree

Mirrored from [Apollo-Reborn v1.15.11_4.0.0](https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/releases/tag/v1.15.11_4.0.0). These IPAs are the **official Apollo-Reborn builds**, re-hosted here so this long-standing AltStore source keeps working for existing users. Apollo-Reborn also runs its own website and sources at https://apolloreborn.app --- ### Features - Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it - Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle) - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout - Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1) - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session - Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle) - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset - Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen - Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Rebuild **Recently Read** as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts - Add **Recently Visited** subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII) - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups - Add **Add Downvote Tap** under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf) - Add a **Subreddit Icon** switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Feature seasonal icons in **Daily Spotlight** around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Tint **Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames** purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make **Bug Reports** attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde) - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable ### Performance - Reduce unnecessary **API-Key-Free** requests

Features • Add an in-app update prompt: from the next release on, Apollo Reborn checks for updates once a day and, when one is out, lets you send it to AltStore, SideStore, Feather, or FlareStore or download the IPA, with the release notes a tap away (#1343: @IllIIllIllIllII) • Tap Later or Skip this version to put it off, check any time with Check for Updates (About), or turn off Automatic Update Checks (Privacy, on by default); # Changelog ## 1.0.0 (build 3) First release. - SEGA Superstars Tennis (Xbox 360) on iPhone and iPad, recompiled with the iOS port of ReXGlue and drawn through Vulkan on Metal (MoltenVK). iOS 15 or later. - Direct Xbox 360 ISO/XISO loading with **Choose ISO**, or extracted disc files in the app's `game` folder. - Matches at up to 60 FPS, capped at 60. CPU readback of the shaders' memory exports is off by default: it made the GPU thread wait for the GPU 30-50 times a frame (12-14 FPS in a match on an iPhone 14 Pro Max). - The game's busy waits (Direct3D's wait for the GPU, the audio threads' barrier) sleep briefly instead of spinning a core, which keeps the phone cooler during long sessions. - The picture stays landscape and sharp after Notification Center, Control Center, screenshots and app switches. iOS lays the window out in portrait for its background snapshot, and the swap chain used to stay portrait afterwards. - On-screen touch controls when no controller is connected; MFi, Xbox and PlayStation controllers. - Pause and resume on app switches and locking; game language from the device; shader and pipeline caches kept across launches; Apple Game Mode.

versions.localizedDescription: KartPad 0.8.6 (build 268) fixes PadMint builds, which had stopped for everyone after an upstream change, gives the game your country for the online flag and globe, adds two speed options for slower Android phones and custom GPU drivers for Snapdragon phones, brings in WiiCompiled's fixes through v0.9.0, makes the Android game code faster, and lets Android players try WiiCompiled 0.9's new graphics engine. Retro Rewind stays at 6.13.4. ### New - **Your country online:** Mario Kart Wii reads your country from the Wii's system settings, and KartPad never provided it, so online matchmaking showed no flag and put your Mii in the wrong place on the globe. KartPad now gives the game a country, the same way a Wii does: your device's region, or on Android one you choose. On Android, change it in **⋯ → Multiplayer → Country…**. Your Mii goes on the globe at your country's capital. Existing saves load as before, with no "create new save data" prompt, in Original and Retro Rewind ([#511](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/511)). - **30 FPS Races (Android):** **⋯ → Graphics & Performance → 30 FPS Races** switches single-player races to the game's own 30 FPS mode, the one it uses for 3 and 4 players. The race runs at normal speed while the game draws half as often, so a phone that slows down at 60 FPS can play at full speed. Time Trials and ghost races stay at 60 FPS. Off by default ([#339](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/339), [#510](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/510)). - **Simpler Computer Karts (Android):** **⋯ → Graphics & Performance → Simpler Computer Karts** gives computer karts the simpler models the game uses in split-screen. They look less detailed and their drivers don't animate; your kart, ghosts and online players are unchanged. Off by default. Thanks to [DriftDroid](https://github.com/dorPXP/driftdroid), where this idea comes from. - **Custom GPU drivers (Android, Snapdragon):** **⋯ → Graphics & Performance → GPU Driver** installs a driver package (the AdrenoTools `.zip` format other Android emulators use, such as Turnip) and uses it with either graphics engine. Many Adreno graphics faults are driver bugs, and a newer driver is the only fix for those. If a driver doesn't load, or graphics can't start with it, or the game closes twice while starting, KartPad goes back to the phone's own driver by itself. Problem reports say which driver was running. - **Choose your graphics engine on Android (beta):** WiiCompiled 0.9 replaced its graphics layer with a newer one. KartPad 0.8.6 for Android ships both. **Classic** is the default and keeps every KartPad graphics fix, including the Adreno character and track workarounds. **WiiCompiled 0.9 (Beta)** uses the new renderer. Switch in **⋯ → Graphics & Performance → Graphics Engine** or with **Graphics** on the KartPad start screen; the game restarts, and your saves, settings and controller assignments stay. If anything looks wrong, switch back to Classic; if the beta closes twice while starting, KartPad goes back to Classic by itself. The beta starts with shaders recorded on the menus and seven Mushroom and Flower Cup courses, and prepares every shader it has seen at launch, so other courses may pause briefly only the first time you visit them. The first time it starts after installing or updating, the beta prepares these shaders behind a "Compiling shaders" screen; on a Pixel 9 Pro XL that took about 20 seconds. Each engine keeps its own shaders, so switching engines doesn't make either one compile them again. Of KartPad's Adreno workarounds, the beta has only the native uniform buffers option in **Android Graphics Diagnostics…**; the vertex and matrix workarounds are Classic only. Phones with a Qualcomm Adreno GPU get a warning before trying it. On Android the beta now asks the display for the game's frame rate, as Classic does, and if Vulkan isn't available it stops with a clear message instead of starting without graphics. Problem rep

KartPad 0.8.5 (build 267) updates Retro Rewind to 6.13.4 and adds the requested rumble-strength and stick-click controls on Android, plus a quicker touch item hold on Android and iPhone/iPad. ### Added - **Android rumble strength:** in **Controls → Controller Button Mapping…**, adjust **Rumble strength** from 0% to 200%. 100% is the standard setting; lower it for gentler feedback or raise it for stronger feedback. It applies to controller motors and the device-vibration fallback for handheld controls. The existing **Rumble** switch still turns both off. Devices without amplitude control may not change physical strength. - **L3 and R3 mappings on Android:** either stick click is now a mapping option. Map **D-pad Up — Trick / Wheelie** to L3 or R3 to trick without reaching for the D-pad. Existing mappings stay the same until you change them. ### Changed - **Retro Rewind 6.13.4:** updated the official pack, code hashes and compiled game code together. Install the matching content through **Download / Update Retro Rewind…** after updating KartPad. Existing saves, ghosts and imported soundtrack files are preserved by the update path. - **Quicker touch item hold:** with the optional setting enabled, hold touch L for 0.67 seconds instead of one second to keep the item held behind your kart. Tap L again to let go. This applies to Android and iPhone/iPad; touch auto-accelerate still uses one second ([#473](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/473)). ### Updating - **Android:** **Update available → Update Now**, or install the APK over your current KartPad. Don't uninstall first. Then update Retro Rewind to 6.13.4 in KartPad. - **iPhone and iPad:** build 0.8.5 with the latest [PadMint](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/padmint/releases/latest) and install over your current KartPad with the same sideloading tool and Apple ID. Then update Retro Rewind in KartPad. The `ios-for-padmint.ipa` is an input for PadMint and does not contain game code. - **Apple Silicon Mac:** rebuild through PadMint, choose **Mario Kart Wii → This Mac**, and select the matching 6.13.4 Retro Rewind data produced by that build. Your saves stay. ### Validation scope Gameplay, emulator and physical-device testing were skipped at the owner's request. This release does not claim a graphics or performance fix. Existing missing-character reports remain open. Android and iOS compiled from the clean release commit. The Android APK passed both package audits, two independent signed derivations were byte-identical, and its signing identity matches 0.8.4. The iOS PadMint input passed the final package audit and contains no game code. The compiled Android package contains the new control UI and matching Retro Rewind 6.13.4 pack. The source archive includes reviewed translator marker strings and synthetic test fixtures. The Android-only translated-code findings are the documented KartPad release exception; no private game inputs or signing material are packaged. Mac: the required clean PadMint player build passed before tagging, using Apple Python 3.9 and an empty PadMint folder. Its 0.8.5/build 267 app passed deep signature verification.

KartPad 0.8.4 (build 266) adds rumble on Android, Retro Rewind soundtrack packs, an optional touch item hold and a new test for invisible characters on Snapdragon phones. iPhone and iPad copies that still need their PadMint build now say so, and PadMint builds ride out dropped downloads. ### Added - **Rumble on Android:** rumble never worked on Android. Controllers with their own motor now rumble. When player one's controller has no motor, such as a handheld's built-in controls, the device itself vibrates, as in Dolphin. A **Rumble** switch in **Controls → Controller Button Mapping…** is on by default and turns both off. Touch-only play doesn't vibrate ([#497](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/497)). - **Retro Rewind soundtrack packs:** add `.brstm` files, or a soundtrack pack's `.zip`, in **Game Data & Saves → Retro Rewind Music…** on Android and iPhone/iPad. A file named like one of Retro Rewind's tracks (for example `104_N.brstm`, and `104_F.brstm` for the final lap) replaces it the next time KartPad starts, and your music stays when Retro Rewind updates. On a Mac, put the files in the `MyStuff` folder of the `RetroRewind6` folder you chose ([#441](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/441), [#499](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/499)). - **Touch item hold** (Android and iPhone/iPad, off by default): in **Controls → Touch Control Settings**. Holding touch L for one second keeps your item held behind the kart, so you can steer and drift while trailing a shell or banana. Press L again to let go ([#473](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/473), [#500](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/500)). - **Android graphics:** **Help → Character Graphics Test → Experimental: bone index per vertex** is a new attempt for Snapdragon phones where riders are invisible or only their heads show. It hasn't been tried on an affected phone yet, so a log with it on helps ([#104](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/issues/104), [#498](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/498)). ### Changed - **iPhone and iPad:** the `ios-for-padmint.ipa` on the releases page has no game code; PadMint adds it. Installed by itself, or over an older KartPad that already had game data, it used to say **Ready to play** and then stop at a PadMint message that only mentioned a Mac. Now the game cards say **Needs your PadMint build**, the message explains that PadMint runs on a Mac, Windows or Linux computer and that saves and imported game data stay, and **Help → Getting Started** starts with the PadMint step ([#494](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/494)). Copies built with PadMint are unchanged. - **PadMint builds:** a dropped or stalled download (the Retro Rewind pack, the Retro-WFC payload, Dawn or `sse2neon.h`) is tried again up to three times instead of stopping the build with "Remote end closed connection without response". If it still fails, the message names the server and says it's a network problem ([#495](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/495)). - **PadMint recipe:** iPhone, iPad and Android builds ask for 16 GB free instead of 60 GB, the measured need ([#490](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/kartpad/pull/490)). Retro Rewind stays at 6.13.3. ### Updating - **Android:** **Update available → Update Now**, or install the APK over your current KartPad. Saves, licenses, ghosts and game data stay. - **iPhone, iPad and Mac:** build 0.8.4 with the latest [PadMint](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/padmint/releases/latest) and install it over your current KartPad with the same sideloading tool and Apple ID. Saves and game data stay.

versions.localizedDescription: ## New - **Back Up Photos in Shortcuts (iOS 16+).** ([#7](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/7)) Add it to a personal automation — when the iPhone connects to power, at a time of day, or when it joins your home Wi-Fi — and set it to run immediately. Each run finds new photos in your selected albums and hands them to iOS to upload in the background. It works with **Automatic Backup** off, so a schedule of your own can replace it ([#14](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/14)), and it still follows **Use Connection** and **Pause**. **Settings → Shortcuts** shows when it last ran and what it did. iOS gives each run about 30 seconds, so the action spends them finding and preparing photos, then leaves the uploads to iOS. With the app open it just adds to the queue — the uploads you are watching are not interrupted. Photos stored only in iCloud still wait until you open the app. - **Diagnostic reports you can attach to an issue.** **Settings → Support → Create Diagnostic Report** builds a text file you can share or copy. It opens with **What stands out** — the likely reason backup is not happening, in plain words (Background App Refresh off, Low Power Mode, a paused or stopped queue, no background window from iOS in days, too little free space, and more). Below that: your settings, the last 40 runs, crash and termination data from iOS, the upload queue, and a timeline of what the app did and why. It leaves out credentials, account addresses, photo identifiers, filenames, media, and links, so it is safe to post publicly. - **See when iOS actually runs the backup.** **Settings → Support → Diagnostics → Recent Runs** lists every run — opening the app, **Back Up Now**, Shortcuts, and the background windows iOS grants — with the time it started, how long it took, what it did, and the conditions it ran under (network, battery and charging, Low Power Mode, locked or not). Background windows also record how long after the request iOS started them. - **Event Timeline.** Every decision the app makes now leaves an entry saying why: why a background run was or wasn't requested, why uploads paused, which step an upload failed at and what Google said, when an item waited for iCloud, what iOS delivered while the app was closed. It keeps two weeks of history; repeats fold into one line, and warnings and errors are kept longer than routine entries, so a big backup does not push out the one failure that matters. - **Storage.** **Settings → Support → Storage** shows what the app keeps on your phone — pending upload copies, backup history, transfer receipts, caches — and **Clean Up Unused Data** removes leftovers without touching pending uploads or your account. ## Fixed - **One photo can no longer make the app close on every launch.** ([#13](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/13)) If the app stopped while preparing a photo or video, the next launch started with that same item, so a single file that took the app down meant it closed again every time you opened it and nothing else backed up. Now an item the app stopped on goes to the end of the queue, and if it stops the app a second time it is skipped with an explanation — tap it to retry. Everything else keeps backing up. Suspending the app normally never counts against an item, so iOS closing the app in the background does not skip anything. - **Checking a large video uses less memory.** The file is read in pieces, and each piece is now released as soon as it has been checked, instead of possibly being held until the whole video is done. - **The app knows when it last closed unexpectedly.** If it disappears while open, while starting, or during a background run, the next launch records it and the report says so — even when iOS did not share a crash report. - **Leftover transfer receipts are cleaned up.** Receipts that no upload owns any more are removed a day after they were written, and Google's responses are no longer kept in a disk cache. ## Explained - **"Storage save

## Fixed - **"Google returned HTTP 400" during finalization now recovers instead of failing the photo.** A live run against Google reproduced it: an upload whose receipt comes back without its upload token is committed anyway, Google answers *"At least one valid blueprint is required"*, and every retry replayed the same dead receipt. The receipt is now checked where it is produced and where it is used, and a rejected one costs the item one fresh transfer rather than its whole retry budget. Receipts saved by older versions are checked too, so a queue carrying one from before the update recovers on the next attempt. - **A full Google account stops the backup and says so.** It used to arrive as a generic HTTP failure, so the queue kept going and failed every remaining photo the same way, one at a time. Backup now pauses with an explanation and waits — freeing space and tapping **Resume** picks it back up. It does not ask you to reconnect the account, because signing in again does not free storage. - **Every upload commits under the quality setting you have selected now.** The choice between original quality and Storage Saver, and whether the upload counts against your Google storage, was captured when the photo was prepared and then kept with it — so a photo prepared while Storage Saver was on kept uploading as Storage Saver after you turned it off, including after restarting the app. ## Improved - **A failed upload will tell you what Google said.** Tap a failed row for the full reason, selectable, with **Copy Details**. **Diagnostics** keeps the last 25 failures with their error codes and a **Copy All**, and counts how many there have been — the reason used to be a two-line caption that disappeared as soon as the row was retried or cleared. - **Error messages name what failed.** "Google returned HTTP 400 during finalization" rather than "check your connection", and Google's own explanation is decoded instead of shown as a hex dump. - **A long backup no longer slows down as it progresses.** The activity list, navigation, and the uploads themselves got slower the further into a whole-library backup you were: the queue's counters, its row lookups, and its search for the next upload all walked the entire queue on every progress update, and the per-album "backed up" counts re-scanned every selected album on each of those too. All of it is now maintained as it goes, so the cost no longer grows with the size of the queue. ## Notes - 132 tests, 130 passing (2 opt-in live tests skipped). - Verified against Google with a fresh sign-in and synthetic images: authentication, duplicate check, and both the foreground and background upload paths all pass; the HTTP 400 above reproduces only with a deliberately emptied receipt. Why some devices produce an empty receipt is still open — this release makes the queue survive it. - **The Simulator cannot run background uploads or schedule background tasks.** Use a device to exercise real backup behaviour.

Version 0.2 adds a native setup launcher and the first settings pass, plus the controller and New Game renderer fixes. ## What's new - Import your retail PC game folder through Files; check startup files and select Play. - Touch-button and pressed-button opacity sliders. - Controller visibility: Automatic, Always show or Always hide. Hidden controls also stop accepting touch input. - Horizontal/vertical touch-camera sensitivity and invert-Y preference. - Optional compact FPS and average frame-interval display. - Basic logging by default; opt into Detailed for performance samples and bounded traces. - Export a diagnostic report or clear logs with confirmation. - Back up and export existing save slots without replacing the originals. - Settings reset preserves saves, game data and custom button layouts. - App icon for iPhone/iPad. - Includes IndecentDad's physical-controller visibility fix and the MGL texture-deletion fix for the New Game/front-end crash. ## Downloads and installation **Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-iOS-0.2.ipa** is an **unsigned arm64 iPhone/iPad build**, version 0.2 (build 2), targeting iOS 15.0 or later. Sign it with your own Apple account using a compatible sideloading tool. This is not an App Store or universally signed IPA. **No retail game files are included.** This is the **PAL/EFIGS PC-data build**. Import your own compatible installed retail PC game folder using the launcher, or transfer it into Documents/game through Files/Finder. Console ISOs and ZIP import are not supported. Install over the existing app using the same signing identity/bundle identifier to retain its data. Back up your saves first. Deleting the app also deletes its local game data and backups. The inspected IPA contains the executable, dependencies, touch-control artwork, app icon and release documentation. It contains no game_assets folder, retail game archives, save slots or embedded signing profile. - **Source code (zip / tar.gz)**: GitHub's archives for this tag, below. - **Release-Documentation-0.2.zip**: installation, launcher/settings guide, controls, credits and dependency notices; also included in the IPA. - **ffmpeg-6.0.tar.xz**: unmodified source for the statically linked FFmpeg dependency. Build options are in ios-project/build-ffmpeg.sh. - **SHA256SUMS.txt**: checksums for the uploaded packages. See [installation](https://github.com/creeper4004/The-Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-iOS/blob/v0.2/INSTALLATION.md), [settings and save backups](https://github.com/creeper4004/The-Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-iOS/blob/v0.2/ios-project/SETTINGS.md), and [known issues](https://github.com/creeper4004/The-Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-iOS/blob/v0.2/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). ## Validation and limitations Device and simulator Release builds passed. Automated checks cover settings policies, value clamping, frame-rate measurement, diagnostic filtering/clearing, persistent-log concurrency/rotation, startup-file validation and the texture-deletion regression. Simulator UI checks covered settings persistence, diagnostic export, and byte-for-byte save-backup copying with the original retained. The user confirmed FPS display and controller visibility on iPhone 17 Pro Max / iOS 27.2 beta. Prior user retests confirmed game-folder import and that the New Game crash no longer occurred. Broader devices/data editions, longer sessions and full-story completion remain unverified. The FPS display measures game frame submissions and average frame interval, not GPU execution time. Basic versus Detailed logging has not been performance-benchmarked. Save restoration is manual through Files; there is no automatic restore button in this release. This unofficial iOS adaptation builds on [Carlox33's Android port](https://github.com/Carlox33/The-Simpsons-Hit-and-Run-Android) and ZenoArrows' earlier platform ports. See the included credits and third-party notices.

### English / Changed - **iOS 18 is now supported.** The deployment target drops from iOS 27 to iOS 18.0; the supported range is **iOS/iPadOS 18.0 – 27.2 B2**, and later versions cannot be supported. Below iOS 27 the system does not support on-device pairing — generate a pairing file on a computer with [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) or [idevice_pair](https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice_pair) and import it. - **The switch is gone.** The home screen now shows two independent actions: **Silence recording tone**, and either **Back Up Original Tones** (shown until a complete backup exists) or **Restore original tone**. The current tone state is no longer displayed — detecting it needs a device read that is unreliable on some iOS releases. Successful operations confirm with an alert instead. - The home page version line shows the running system version beside the app version, e.g. `iOS 27.1 AirBeep v2.5.1 (9)` (`iPadOS` on iPad). - Backup is a standalone action: back the originals up before silencing so they are always recoverable; the button then flips to Restore. The automatic-backup note sits under that button. ### English / Fixed - **Flaky airlift reads no longer abort the whole operation.** Each tone file is read independently; a failed read is skipped and logged instead of failing the silence/restore. The write channel's return code is the source of truth, and read-back verification degrades to a log entry when a re-read is unavailable. - **Loopback connect no longer falsely demands Wi-Fi.** Wi-Fi presence is now read from the live interface table (`getifaddrs`) instead of `NWPathMonitor`, which reports unsatisfied once the VPN owns the default path. Wi-Fi is still required. - The third writable tone file `StartDisclosure.caf` is now replaced too (skipped automatically on releases that do not ship it). - Restore without a backup explains the language-change recovery path instead of failing with a generic "no backup" error. - Removed the non-public-behavior disclaimer from the bottom of the home page. ### English / Added - **Advanced settings** (About page): set a custom device IP for the loopback connection, and inspect the live network-interface table with tunnel/Wi-Fi state — self-diagnosis for the "connection refused / wrong subnet" reports. - Runtime interface scan: tunnel dials now adapt to the actual network via `al_set_target_hosts` without any route probing. - Localization hardened: two validation scripts keep the EN/zh-Hans catalogs in sync (identical keys, matching placeholders, no untranslated UI literals). --- ### 中文 / 变更 - **支持 iOS 18。** 最低系统要求由 iOS 27 降至 iOS 18.0，支持范围为 **iOS/iPadOS 18.0 – 27.2 B2**，之后的版本无法支持。iOS 27 以下的系统 不支持本机配对，请在电脑上用 [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) 或 [idevice_pair](https://github.com/jkcoxson/idevice_pair) 生成配对文件后导入。 - **取消开关设计。** 首页改为两个独立操作：**静音录音提示音**，以及 **备份原始提示音**（尚无完整备份时显示）或 **恢复原始提示音**。不再显示 当前提示音状态——检测状态需要在部分 iOS 版本上不可靠的设备读取；操作 成功后以弹窗提示。 - 首页版本行在软件版本号左侧显示当前系统版本，例如 `iOS 27.1 AirBeep v2.5.1 (9)`（iPad 上显示 `iPadOS`）。 - 备份成为独立操作：可先备份再静音，原音始终可找回；按钮随后切换为恢复， 自动备份说明位于该按钮下方。 ### 中文 / 修复 - **airlift 读取偶发失败不再导致整个操作中断。** 每个提示音文件独立读取， 失败仅跳过并记录日志；以写入通道的返回码为准，回读校验在无法读取时 降级为日志记录。 - **回环连接不再误报"需要连接 Wi-Fi"。** Wi-Fi 状态改由实时接口表 （`getifaddrs`）判断，不再使用在 VPN 接管默认路由后总报告不可用的 `NWPathMonitor`。Wi-Fi 仍为必需条件。 - 同时替换第三个可写提示音文件 `StartDisclosure.caf`（未提供该文件的 系统版本自动跳过）。 - 无备份时的恢复会明确指引"更改系统语言"恢复路径，不再报模糊的 "无备份"错误。 - 删除首页底部"依赖非公开系统行为"的免责提示。 ### 中文 / 新增 - **高级设置**（关于页）：可为回环连接设置自定义设备 IP，并查看带 隧道/Wi-Fi 状态的实时网络接口列表，自行排查"连接被拒绝 / 网段不对"问题。 - 运行时接口扫描：通过 `al_set_target_hosts` 让隧道拨号适配实际网络， 不做任何路由探测。 - 本地化加固：新增两个校验脚本保证中英文目录一致（键相同、占位符匹配、 无未翻译界面文案）。 --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LinkPass888/AirBeep/compare/v2.4.1...v2.5.1

# Theft4 0.3.2 — potential BC texture preparation fix **Version 0.3.2 · build 144 · iPhone and iPad · 2026-10-14** This release addresses a confirmed scanner/cache bug behind repeated **“No supported static BC textures were found”** errors. It is a **potential fix** for reports from older phones, including iPhone 12 Pro and iPhone 13 Pro. It does not establish the cause of every report or guarantee older-device compatibility or performance. **I don't have an older phone, so I cannot test these changes on one. Your mileage may vary (YMMV).** ## What changed - A scan that finds zero textures is scanned again on retry instead of repeatedly reusing a failed result. - Restoring or replacing `aes_key.bin` invalidates the saved source scan. Older scan identities are refreshed once; existing converted textures can still be reused by their content keys. - Empty-scan errors now show the source-file count, resources decoded, warning count and first underlying archive/resource warning. - **Download Latest Log Capture** now includes a bounded texture scan summary, so reports can distinguish missing sources, unreadable archives and unmatched texture layouts. The older-device path prepares supported static 2D BC1/BC2/BC3 textures as ASTC. Devices whose GPU supports BC directly skip this requirement. This is not a fix for every graphics or gameplay issue. ## Required game version and exact title update Use your own legally obtained **Grand Theft Auto IV for Xbox 360, USA retail**, with this exact supported pair: | Requirement | Supported value | | --- | --- | | Title ID | `545407F2` | | USA retail media ID | `6AC07221` | | Base executable version | `0.0.0.5` | | Title update | **GTA IV Title Update 8 (TU8)** matching that base/media ID | | Update source → target | `0.0.0.5` → `0.0.8.5` | | Extracted `default.xexp` SHA-256 | `480aee5e2b42707791e7571bb8407c5bb3f6c7534f07f9beb426db4cfc648fd3` | These are the supported game/update requirements for Theft4, including BC-to-ASTC texture preparation. PC/PS3 assets, another retail revision, an unrelated update, or renamed incompatible files are not substitutes. An ISO working in an emulator does not establish compatibility with Theft4. Use the [validated staging and installation instructions](https://github.com/KoreanSeats1/Theft4/blob/v0.3.2/docs/IOS_SIDELOAD_INSTALL.md). Copy the prepared folder's contents into the existing **Files → On My iPhone/iPad → Theft4 → game** folder. Keep `default.xex`, the matching `default.xexp`, `aes_key.bin`, and the complete staged archives/resources in their required locations; avoid `game/game`. A raw ISO or unopened update package is not a prepared installation. Executable/update verification alone does not prove every texture source is present or readable. ## Update and retry 1. Download **`Theft4-0.3.2-144-ios-arm64.ipa`** and its checksum from the [release assets](https://github.com/KoreanSeats1/Theft4/releases/tag/v0.3.2). The IPA is unsigned; sign/install it with your compatible sideloading tool. 2. **Update the existing app in place. Do not delete it:** deletion removes its private saves and caches. 3. Open Theft4, check the game files, and retry texture preparation if your GPU requires it. Allow a fresh source scan; completed conversion files remain reusable. 4. Keep Theft4 open during preparation, preferably on power. Allow roughly 2.4 GB for prepared textures plus additional free working space. Pause/resume retains completed conversions. Requires ARM64 iOS/iPadOS 26.0 or later. This GitHub sideload release is separate from TestFlight. ## Bug reports need logs and information **Without logs or information I cannot help you with “it doesn't work.”** After a failure, return to the launcher and use **System → Download Latest Log Capture**. Preparation failures do not require starting gameplay or enabling a long performance capture. Attach the exported file to the [Theft4 Tester Log & Bug Submission form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZNq2hjni8wgCh

# Theft4 0.3.1 — Performance Improvements **iPhone and iPad · version 0.3.1 · build 142** A performance follow-up to the direct Metal release: less repeated CPU work, cheaper first-use geometry, fewer allocations and better cache behavior. The original Theft4 icon is back. ## What changed - Faster cold geometry conversion and reusable immutable upload backing. - Less work per draw through cached shader metadata, pooled bindings and reusable frame bookkeeping. - Warm pipeline recipes survive cache pressure instead of being cleared together. - Upload VM allocation runs outside the cache mutex; retired sources are cleaned up incrementally and in-flight GPU resources retain their data. - Less CPU busy polling and allocation in multi-object waits. - Native attachment optimizations reduce proven redundant clear/load/store work while preserving the intended image. - Improved compact iPhone launcher layouts. ## Optional Mods menu - **Native Aspect Ratio:** expand the viewport to the launch-window shape, with matching camera/lighting reconstruction, odd-size effects fixes and proportional pause-menu/radar corrections. More visible scenery can increase frame time. - **Custom Time Cycle:** lighting/weather replacement for loose and packed installs. **Credit and thanks to SBerrix** for the custom time cycle. - **God Mode:** player damage/death protection. - **Unlimited Ammo:** reserve ammunition stays available while magazines deplete and reload normally. Select mods before Play; changes take effect on a fresh game launch. The realistic vehicle-handling mod remains planned work and is not included. ## Older devices GPUs without BC-texture support retain the one-time BC-to-ASTC preparation flow: progress, ETA, pause/resume and a saved cache reused on later launches. The tested A12Z uses it; the tested M5 supports BC directly and skips it. The check uses GPU capability rather than an age cutoff. Updating in place retains existing caches. ## Validation and current limits 33 native contracts, 9 mod contracts and 45 real-Metal graphics cases pass, alongside CPU wait sanitizer checks and Release optimization verification. The target remains under 30 ms of total frame work. Remaining first-use spikes, heavy views and device-specific performance are still being improved; this is not a universal locked-30-FPS guarantee. Host fixture savings are not whole-game FPS percentages. Optional mod coverage still needs broader gameplay testing.
