**Frame rate cap** @Henyckma added an FPS cap that limits presentation only. The game and the audio keep running at full speed, so it costs nothing in emulation and gives back battery and heat instead. Targets are 15, 23.976, 29.94, 30, 45, 59.97, 60, 90 and 120, set globally or per game. The gain is biggest at 2x and 3x internal resolution, where the passes it skips cover the most pixels. Selecting 30 FPS used to halve emulation and audio speed, which is fixed, and FPS profiles from earlier builds carry over without losing the cadence you picked. **Crashes and freezes** Fixed a crash in games like Namco Museum 50th Anniversary, which turned out to be an out of bounds write in the virtual memory page protection table. Fixed a freeze in readback heavy scenes with Hardware Download Mode set to Unsynchronized. Rogue Galaxy no longer stalls the graphics thread around 7.5 ms every frame on a depth probe readback, about a fifth of the frame on an M2. The last two are bmdhacks. Saving per game settings could also leave the game frozen a second or two later, which is covered below. **Sprite hacks** Align Sprite and Merge Sprite apply when you switch them off. This was the third report of that bug and the fifth attempt at it, and the earlier ones all fixed the global screen while leaving everything around it alone. Per game, those rows greyed out whenever GameDB Graphics Fixes was on, kept showing their old value, and got written back on every save. Align Sprite, Merge Sprite and Wild Arms Offset are one Use Global / Off / On picker each now, and they no longer need manual hacks mode. Setting one claims that fix, so the game database stops overriding it while keeping every other fix for the game. Texture Inside RT, Native Scaling, Bilinear Upscale, Unscaled Palette Draw, Preload Frame Data and Disable Partial Invalidation had the same bug and were fixed with it. None of these do anything at 1x internal resolution, which is by design. **Per-game settings** Turning on Use Per-Game Overrides used to soften text and edges: enabling it copied six graphics keys into the per game file, and one of those forced a blend deinterlace that also suppressed the game's own database fix. Only the settings you change are written now. Saving in that panel could also leave the game frozen a second or two later while the emulator carried on at full speed, because metadata scans share one disc image with the running game and a scan during play left it holding a closed disc. The Renderer picker never saved a change made while a game was running, so it never applied either. It saves now, and it moved from Fixes & Compatibility to the Graphics tab where people kept looking for it. It still applies at the next boot of that game. Saving the panel is quicker too: it used to fire one full settings reload per field written, 71 of them for a single Save. **Settings** Every slider, stepper and typed number is one control now, and each setting is described once instead of once per screen. The FPS target had three different sets of bounds across three screens. Sliders stop on values people actually pick, every stop list holds the default so reset lands on one, and typing still reaches anything in between. Per game numbers can inherit the global value instead of choosing from a short list. The dynamic background sliders stay continuous, since every value there is a legitimate one, but they snap to the precision they print: a row could read 50% while storing 0.4973, which also left the reset arrow comparing against the hidden value. Applying the Default preset asks first and then resets every setting, with the Default row showing as active afterwards, and Reset Graphics and Reset Emulator no longer reach into settings they do not show or drag Frame Pacing to Custom on the way. Buffer Size and Output Latency are sliders on Frame Pacing now, matching the Audio screen, and GS Back Thread says it needs a restart instead of looking broken. The preset fixes are @Henyckma's. **

2.5.1 is mostly a fixes release. The two biggest issues were A12 devices crashing on launch and rumble being completely broken since 2.4.1. Both are fixed, along with a proper no-JIT fallback, several performance improvements, and a collection of Virtual Pad and interface fixes. ## Highlights * Fixed launch crashes on A12 devices * Controller and phone rumble work again * Added improved phone rumble with separate motor handling and a strength setting — @Henyckma * Added a proper no-JIT fallback and improved interpreter performance — @Henyckma * Fixed a Devil May Cry crash during FMVs * Added fractional Internal Resolution options up to 3.5x * Reduced graphics overhead in several games — @bmdhacks * Improved Rogue Galaxy performance — @bmdhacks * Virtual Pad and layout improvements — @Henyckma * GameDB and cheat-loading fixes — @jpolo1224 ## A12 Devices Fixed launch crashes on iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, iPad Air 3, iPad mini 5, iPad 8 and A12X/A12Z iPad Pro. 2.5.0 was accidentally built with an Apple M1 CPU baseline. iOS now targets `apple-a12`, the oldest device we support. ## Rumble Controller and phone rumble work again after being broken since 2.4.1. @Henyckma also reworked phone rumble. It is now sustained, responds properly to motor strength, handles the two PS2 motors separately, and ramps in and out more naturally. A Phone Rumble Strength setting has been added, and Test Rumble now works without a controller connected. Several controller-rumble bugs were fixed at the same time, including a leak, a threading issue and cases where rumble could be routed to the wrong player. ## Playing Without JIT @Henyckma added a proper fallback for devices where JIT is unavailable. Instead of crashing or showing a black screen, ARMSX2 now falls back to interpreter implementations where possible. Interpreter performance was improved at the same time. On the test device and workload, EE time went from 37.55 ms to 30.55 ms, about 18.6% less. Results vary by game, device and thermal state. ## Crashes and Stability Fixed a Devil May Cry crash when the game switches to the software renderer for FMVs. Several related JIT and software-renderer stability issues were fixed as well, including problems affecting legacy JIT mode under LiveContainer. Fastmem now stays disabled correctly when its required 4 GB virtual mapping cannot be allocated, and a race in the JIT keepalive path was narrowed. ## Graphics and Performance @bmdhacks reduced unnecessary render-pass and copy work. Across a five-loop replay: * Rogue Galaxy: 2,411 → 1,741 render passes * OutRun 2006: 1,240 → 1,118 render passes Vertex processing was also reduced in cases where an auto-flush cannot occur. Dragon Quest VIII measured 4.7% fewer graphics-thread cycles in testing. Internal Resolution now includes: `1.25x`, `1.5x`, `1.75x`, `2.25x`, `2.5x`, `2.75x` and `3.5x` ## Game Database @bmdhacks improved Rogue Galaxy performance by disabling auto-flush for the game. Render passes fall 38% and texture copies 74%, worth about 1.8 ms per frame and 2.6 fps on a low-end device. There is a small visual trade-off: some lamp lighting can appear slightly brighter and warmer than the software renderer reference. Four side-by-side comparisons at 1:1 failed to distinguish the two, but please report it if you notice it during normal play. Need for Speed Underground 1 and 2 now run without hardware readbacks — @jpolo1224. Cheats stored under the generic all-CRC file name work again — @jpolo1224. ## Virtual Pad All of this is @Henyckma's. Dynamic Thumbstick feedback now pulses once when crossing the maximum-pull threshold instead of repeating continuously. Swipe Camera gets the same feedback once it becomes a joystick, and now uses the full left half of the screen on iPad. Saved layouts now have Rename, Share and Delete options. Device Presets no longer change Aspect Ratio or treat it as part of whether a preset is active. ## Interface Fixes * Fixed a crash when toggling Low Power Mode with a video wallpa

ARMSX2 2.5.0 is a major update to the emulator core and the iOS frontend. The biggest core change is a new shared ARM64 recompiler, replacing the older iOS-specific EE, IOP and VU recompilers. It brings iOS in line with the ARM handheld builds, reduces CPU overhead in several parts of emulation, and restores features the previous iOS backend did not support correctly. The release also moves iOS onto the shared game database used by the other mobile ARM builds. That brings a large set of newer per-game fixes and tuning to iOS. Outside the core, 2.5.0 adds Dynamic Controls, animated backgrounds, settings presets, improved frame pacing, proper 120 Hz support, an in-app controller-skin browser, RetroAchievements fixes, OSD improvements, and a long list of graphics and stability fixes. Almost none of this is my own work. The core belongs to @bmdhacks, the new iOS interface and control features to @Henyckma, and the rest to @pstef, @jpolo1224, @XDarkFallenX and Mart. Thanks to all of them, and to everyone who tested development builds and reported problems. ## Highlights * New shared ARM64 recompiler for the EE, IOP and vector units, from @bmdhacks * Updated shared game database with newer fixes and tuning for more than a thousand games * Dynamic Thumbsticks, Swipe Camera, Gyroscope Camera and Dynamic Actions, from @Henyckma * Twelve Metal-rendered Dynamic Background styles, from @Henyckma * Six settings presets plus import and export, from @Henyckma * Emulation-Only Mode, which frees the device to the emulator once a game is running, from @Henyckma * Reworked frame-pacing controls and per-game presets * Proper 120 Hz support on ProMotion devices * Apple GPU fixes for speckled graphics in games such as Black and God of War II, from @bmdhacks * Fixes for upscaling hacks and settings that previously appeared not to apply * In-app controller-skin browser and more reliable skin importing * Working RetroAchievements statistics, achievement lists and native notifications * OSD safe-area, rotation and performance-overlay fixes * Several iOS crashes and core correctness bugs fixed ## New ARM64 Recompiler ARMSX2 now uses the newer shared ARM64 recompiler family written by @bmdhacks and tested primarily on ARM handheld hardware, replacing the older iOS-specific implementations. The new backend has had considerably more testing, including differential tests that compare recompiled EE, IOP and VU execution against other emulator implementations. It also contains substantial optimization work around register handling, larger compiled blocks, vector instructions, calls and returns, unaligned memory accesses, and self-modifying code. Several features that were missing from the previous iOS backend are also supported now: * Dynamic game patches can be applied from the game database. Entries such as the ones used by Armored Core: Nine Breaker and Ratchet & Clank 2 previously had no effect on iOS. * Goemon's TLB handling now has the required preload and invalidation hooks. The fix remains behind the existing game fix and would still benefit from a complete playthrough test. * Delay-slot swapping is supported where the PS2 allows it. The JIT has also been adapted to the different executable-memory paths used by the app, including the iOS 26 TXM paths, Simulator support, and the legacy path used on iOS 18 and earlier. ## Game Compatibility iOS no longer ships its own separate merged game database. ARMSX2 now uses the shared database. The move onto the shared resources was done by @bmdhacks. The previous iOS copy had fallen behind upstream. With the shared database, more than a thousand games have different behavioral entries compared with 2.4.1, and future mobile fixes no longer need to be copied separately into the iOS version. Some of the more visible changes include: * Hardware-readback tuning is now actually applied from the game database, thanks to @jpolo1224 making the database key work at all. Forty-eight games currently use it, including Black,

ARMSX2 iOS 2.4.1 is a much bigger follow-up than the version number might suggest. This update adds video library backgrounds, MetalFX upscaling, more flexible controller and RetroAchievements settings, save-state previews, and a long list of interface improvements. There has also been a lot of work under the hood. JIT handling is more resilient, several ARM64 and Metal paths have been improved, and a number of game-specific compatibility problems have been fixed. Thank you to everyone who tested the builds, reported issues, and kept checking the fixes. ## Library backgrounds Library backgrounds have been rebuilt around separate portrait and landscape slots. Setting a portrait background no longer replaces the landscape one, or vice versa. Each slot clearly shows its orientation, file type, and size, so it is easier to see exactly what you are editing. Each orientation also has its own fit mode: * **Fill** fills the screen and crops the edges when necessary. * **Fit** keeps the entire image visible and may add letterboxing. * **Stretch** fills the screen by changing the image proportions. Stretch mode has been fixed so it no longer leaves black bars along the sides in portrait or at the top and bottom in landscape. Alongside static and animated images, the library can now use looping video backgrounds. MP4, MKV, and WebM files can be selected, and the player swaps cleanly when a different video is chosen. Videos resume properly after returning to the app and pause while ARMSX2 is in the background. Background importing is also safer. A failed import can no longer remove or replace the background you were already using. The dimming control now shows a live percentage, making it easier to use the same intensity across different backgrounds. ## Game cards Portrait game cards finally receive the same frosted-glass treatment as their landscape versions. A subtle gradient behind the cards gives the glass something consistent to blur, while Reduce Transparency users receive an opaque fallback. The cards themselves have received a small layout pass: * Titles, file information, size, and region are centered beneath the cover. * Additional padding gives the contents more breathing room. * The favorite star has a lighter and less distracting background. * The BIOS Only button is easier to notice. * Favorite buttons in the list view have a larger and more reliable tap area. ## Save states and memory cards Save states now display the screenshot captured with each state. This should make it much easier to recognise the point in the game you are about to restore. Memory cards can be exported through the standard iOS share sheet. ZIP archives containing memory cards can also be imported directly into the app. ## Gameplay and controls Portrait gameplay uses more of the available screen. The game viewport has been increased from 55% to 60% of the screen height, reducing the unused space between the game and the virtual controller. The in-game pause button now uses a proper pause symbol instead of the previous ellipsis icon. The menu button also has better contrast, helping it remain visible over bright game scenes. ARMSX2 now keeps the display awake while a game is running. ### Stick inversion Each virtual stick axis can be inverted independently: * Left stick horizontal * Left stick vertical * Right stick horizontal * Right stick vertical These options have global defaults and can also be overridden for individual games. The on-screen stick still follows your finger normally; only the input sent to the game is inverted. ### Rumble and haptics When no rumble-capable physical controller is connected, PS2 rumble events can now be translated into iPhone haptic feedback. This respects the existing Haptic Feedback setting and is rate-limited so sustained rumble does not overload the device’s haptic engine. ## Pause menu Long game titles use end truncation instead of cutting text out of the middle, which keeps the beginning of the title readable. New GPU driver source: ExynosTools (WearyConcern1165/ExynosTools) added to the in-app driver downloader, helps Xclipse devices on Vulkan.

ARMSX2 2.6.0.4 What's new: Fast-Forward button in the in-game menu, the Session tab now has a one-tap Fast-Forward (between Continue and Restart). It kicks the game to max speed and resumes, reopen the menu and it shows an "On" state to switch it back off. (Same as the Frame limit button, but more obvious). GPU driver recommendation, added back the feature from the old UI, the driver picker now shows your detected GPU model and the recommended driver source for it. Appears in both the in-game menu's driver section and full Settings. For Gyro, pick the aim stick option, Aim mode can now drive the Right or Left analog stick (per-game), for games that aim with the left stick such as Resident Evil 4. Fixes: Cheats/patches on-off toggle now works on PNACH files saved with (CRLF) line endings, no more "Couldn't update … (unusual formatting)" popup. Fixes to the Online browser manager as well. More GameDB game fixes now baked in, thanks to @XDarkFallenX and tester Jer for helping with these! MotoGP 3: Minimum Blending Level 0, fixes transparency effects Evil Dead: A Fistful of Boomstick, Minimum Blending Level 0, fixes transparency effects Resident Evil: Outbreak, Minimum Blending Level 0, fixes transparency effects Marvel: Ultimate Alliance, Instant VU1 off + MTVU off, fixes broken rendering SBK 09: Superbike World Championship, MTVU off, fixes broken rendering Cy Girls (Ice & Aska discs), Round Sprite 2, fixes NPCs walking on-screen Plus upstream GS texture-cache improvements (better clears, format-overlap handling, preload). Enjoy!

ARMSX2 Refresh 2.6.0.3 What's new: Custom achievement unlock sounds: pick any audio file (like the Xbox 360 achievement sound) for RetroAchievements unlocks, in the RetroAchievements --> options screen. Hide games from your library: long-press a game --> Hide from library, with a Show hidden games toggle to bring them back and un-hide in the dropdown toolbar in the top right. Clear cached data in Settings --> App: frees space by wiping the shader and cover-art caches (they rebuild automatically). Green Play button in a game's per-game settings to launch it directly. Optional game titles under cover art now work in the Shelf library layout as well. Fixes: Per-game settings no longer stick to the last game after closing it, and now open correctly from the Shelf layout. Fixed the ANGLE renderer crashing / black-screening on Mali-G77 devices (Retroid Pocket 4 Pro, etc.). This mode is recommended for many Mali users, and may help other kinds of devices as well. Major Vulkan speedup on Mali GPUs, brought back accurate blending now runs in-tile instead of the slow per-primitive barrier fallback (re-enabled the fast feedback-loop path modern Mali drivers support, was present in V38 but was lost in the unification). The in-game Performance tab is now a yellow ⚡.
2.6.0.2 • Jak 3: per-game graphics fixes (all regions) • New game fixes: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance, Atelier Iris

Fixes: Controller remapping works again, fixes the 2.6.0 regression where the [Bind] popup didn't register button presses. In-game Render tab: picking a resolution below Native now actually applies (was snapping back to Native). RetroAchievements unlock sound no longer occasionally fails to play. New: Black and OLED themes (pure black) alongside System / Light / Dark. Boot BIOS directly with no game, from the menu. Scroll memory, the in-game menu and the Settings screen remember where you were when you reopen them (great for the long Fixes list). RetroAchievements panel shows the game's file type (ISO/CHD/BIN) next to the Hardcore badge. Per-game (GameDB): Ar Tonelico 1 & 2: Round Sprite = Full (vertical lines in FMVs/portraits). Aeon Flux: EE Cycle Rate 130% (performance). Musashi: Samurai Legend: Merge Sprite on (cutscene ghosting). Tekken 4, 5 & Tag Tournament (all regions): clamp fixes (camera, coin-noise, effects). Added a button in the three dot drop down in the top game library toolbar to re-access the setup screen to change APP/BIOS/ROM folder.

Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- microVU0: compute the VU1 register window's address at run time
- Tests: a persisted VU0 program that uses the window onto VU1's registers
- Android: link the core with emulated TLS when the minimum API is below 29
- iOS: give the layout editor and the manifest skin their own views
- iOS: split the patch and skin library stores by their own sections
- iOS: split navigation and gameplay views into one file per view
- iOS: split the controls and skin files along their types
- iOS: split the dynamic backgrounds into one file per background

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261112...37ed35b88fe9a0164369c8042f2c9aa707e33667

apps.name: Fathom
apps.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS. Fathom runs x86-64 Linux programs on an iPhone or iPad by translating them to ARM64 as they execute, using FEXCore - the dynamic recompiler behind FEX-Emu - with a native SwiftUI front end.

Import a statically linked x86-64 Linux executable, open it, press Run. Fathom maps it into a guest address space, hands its instructions to FEXCore's JIT, answers its Linux syscalls, and shows you its output.

JIT requires StikDebug to attach to the process and service the executable-memory traps; Fathom asks for this automatically on launch when it is missing.

Please note: only statically linked, position-independent executables (-static-pie) run today. Dynamically linked binaries and 32-bit x86 are not supported yet, and threads are not implemented, so a guest runs single-threaded.
apps.subtitle: x86-64 PC emulator for iOS

MoviePilot iOS 1.2.2，修复嵌套弹窗动画、iOS 16–25 底栏材质与原生搜索分类配色问题。

### 更新内容

- 修复 App 嵌套打开弹窗时直接切换内容的问题，补齐进入子弹窗、返回父弹窗和高度变化的动画，并适配系统“减弱动态效果”。
- iOS 16–25 的底栏改用超薄系统磨砂材质，保留底页壁纸和明暗主题变化；iOS 26+ 继续使用系统 Liquid Glass。
- 修复旧系统搜索页分类选中态使用相同强调色绘制背景和前景，导致图标与文字消失的问题。
- 保留 iOS 16 设备的原生底栏布局、动态搜索按钮和路由确认行为。

### 安装

下载 `MoviePilot-1.2.2-unsigned.ipa` 后自行重签。本包没有 Apple 证书签名，不能直接安装；原生推送需要开发者团队为 `com.moviepilot.app` 启用 Push Notifications，并使用带该权限的生产描述文件，同时重签小组件、保留一致的 App Groups。免费账户须在重签时移除 `aps-environment`，继续使用主屏幕网页通知。

如果旧版使用 `org.moviepilot.app`，新版会作为独立 App 安装，需要重新登录及绑定通知；旧 App 和数据不会自动迁移或删除。重签后 Bundle ID 与已有安装一致时才能覆盖更新，原生推送还须与 Server 的 topics 允许名单一致。

MoviePilot 后台启用 AppPush 后，在 App **右上角三点 → 连接与显示 → 通知 → 开启系统通知** 中授权，再发送测试通知。Apple `.p8` 私钥、Team ID 与 Key ID 由 Server 配置，App 无需填写。开发签名须同时将 App 的 APNs 环境改为 `development`，不能仅替换描述文件。

此版本无需为此更新前端；独立搜索仍需 [MoviePilot-Frontend v3.2.4](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot-Frontend/releases/tag/v3.2.4) 或更新的兼容版本。真实 Apple 投递、后台及锁屏接收需在具有推送权限的签名和真机上验证。

[安装与续签](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot-App/blob/main/guides/install.md) · [小组件](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot-App/blob/main/guides/widgets.md) · [通知配置](https://github.com/jxxghp/MoviePilot-App/blob/main/guides/notifications.md)

Release 同时提供 `SHA256SUMS`。本包使用 iPhoneOS SDK 和 arm64 架构构建。

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

## Welcome to OpenParsec v2.0.0!

This is the release promised back in 1.4.0, with everything that's been on the nightly since october.

We now have a Metal renderer, streams that hold and reconnect by themselves, new connecting screens,reworked settings, and other control-related improvements.

---

Before you update:
- auto reconnect is now switched on by default, see settings > developer for additional settings
- everyone is now on the new Metal renderer. OpenGL is remains optional as a fallback\
- this is the last release for ios 14. it runs with some rough edges but remains functional. Future releases will be pinned, and we plan to require ios 15 starting from the next release. A seperate branch for iOS 14 will be created for backporting fixes as maintainer time allows

streaming

app

apps.name: Orchard
apps.localizedDescription: Boots a real arm64 macOS Ventura guest on iPhone through Apple's own chain (AVPBooter, iBoot and XNU) on QEMU's apple-vm machine, with the GPU drawn through Metal by reims-vgpu. Requires JIT, a signing tool that adds the increased memory limit, and a macOS VM you make yourself. It is slow — light scenes reach 30–40 fps at best.
apps.subtitle: Apple Silicon macOS Ventura running inside an iPhone app

versions.localizedDescription:
Orchard for iPhone 0.2: a faster emulator and a faster Metal path, plus a fix for guests that end up in Recovery.

Setup and settings: [README](https://github.com/MakrSas/orchard-ios#readme).

## Faster

On an iPhone 15 (A16), light scenes now reach 30–40 frames a second. Dragging a window runs at 10–15 frames a second (in 0.1 it dropped to around 7 once the Dock and menu bar were up).

- **CPU (QEMU TCG)**
  - The jump cache is bigger and better hashed, and keeps each process's blocks across context switches. Block-lookup misses fell from ~15% to ~3%.
  - Changing ASID flushes only the user half of the TLB.
  - The PMU is off, and fewer system-register writes end a translation block or flush the TLB.
- **Fast pointer authentication** (on by default, in Settings → Machine → Processor). The guest still sees PAC, but no signature is computed. That was 10–15% of the emulator's time. Turn it off if macOS stops booting.
- **Metal path (reims-vgpu)**
  - A guest render pass stays on the GPU as one Metal pass, instead of a GPU round trip, a full-frame readback and a re-upload for every draw.
  - Draw buffers come from a shared ring.
  - Shader keys hash faster.
  - Stores write back only the drawn area, with a NEON channel swap straight into guest pages.
- **Tip:** 960×540 at 30 Hz is the sweet spot. In the guest, Reduce transparency helps dragging windows.

## Fixed

- **Guest stuck in Recovery with no disk.** This was macOS installing an automatic update, which cannot complete on this machine. Turn automatic updates off first thing; the README has the settings and the Terminal commands.
- **Disk safety.** The disk is flushed when the app goes to the background and on Shut Down, and the log records guest flushes and I/O errors.

## Also since 0.1

- Sound (experimental, Settings → Machine → Sound).
- A shared folder: Files → Orchard → Shared, mounted in the guest at `http://10.0.2.2:8080`.
- Internet in the guest works.

## You need

- iOS 16 or later, tested on an iPhone 15 with iOS 27, and a phone with 6 GB of memory or more.
- A signing tool that adds the increased memory limit capability, and JIT (such as StikDebug).
- A macOS 13 VM made in UTM on a Mac.

Unofficial, and not affiliated with Apple or ChefKiss. No Apple software is included. Licences: see LICENSE-NOTICE.md.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights

### 🌍 Roam Control in 10 Languages
Choose English, Hebrew, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, French, German or Spanish, or use System Default to select from the supported languages based on your iPhone's language preferences. Switch languages immediately, with right-to-left layout support for Hebrew and Arabic.

### 🗺️ Better Maps and Routes
Refined map controls, route handling and coordinate compatibility, with clearer handling when a route cannot be created.

### 🔄 Smarter Connection Recovery
Improved connection and location-session recovery when the app is allowed to run. iOS may suspend background apps, so unattended recovery cannot be guaranteed.

### 🚶 Your Speed, Your Route
Custom movement speeds for Walking, Cycling and Driving, refined driving targets and travel-time estimates, plus improvements to live walking-speed display.

### ✨ UI Refinements
A clearer language picker with native-language subtitles, improved recovery presentation and better handling of translated text throughout the app.

## What's New

### Localisation
- Eight new languages bring the total to ten, plus System Default.
- Language changes apply immediately without relaunching Roam Control.
- Arabic/Hebrew right-to-left layouts and isolation of PINs, versions and place names.
- Simplified/Traditional Chinese selection respects script and regional language preferences.
- Improved plural forms, multi-argument messages, system permissions text and interface sizing.

### Maps and Movement
- Refined map interaction and coordinate compatibility.
- Improvements to route handling and route-failure feedback.
- Custom Walking, Cycling and Driving movement-speed preferences.
- Better driving speed targets, route time estimates and walking-speed display.

### Connection Health and Recovery
- Improved reconnection and session-recovery behaviour while iOS allows background or foreground execution.
- Refined recovery controls and user guidance.
- Existing LocalDevVPN pairing, diagnostics and Stop & Restore remain available.

## Before You Install
- **iOS 27 or newer** and **Developer Mode** are required.
- **LocalDevVPN is still required** for local pairing connectivity.
- The IPA is **unsigned**. Sign and install it using SideStore or another compatible method.
- For LiveContainer, enable **Fix Local Notifications** before the first launch.

> **Upgrading directly from 0.9.4 or earlier?** Back up favourites, history and supported preferences before migrating to the newer `com.roamcontrol` app identifier. The older app's data will not automatically transfer. Pairing records are not included in backups, so you will need to pair again. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/seanhowarthdev/Roam-Control/blob/main/Documentation/Migration095.md).

## Download and Integrity

**IPA:** `RoamControl-0.9.9-Build105.ipa`

**SHA-256:** `211f1057c70292da468226b39808d8777549c02923c14afc504d9e1d2daba86e`

Thanks to everyone who's tested Roam Control and shared feedback. Please report any issues or language improvements through GitHub Issues or our community Discord.

apps.name: SceneBox
apps.localizedDescription: Torrent streaming client for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS and Mac (Catalyst), written in SwiftUI. Streams come from Stremio-compatible addons and play through a vendored libtorrent engine feeding VLC.
apps.subtitle: Torrent streaming client

versions.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.
apps.subtitle: Native manga & manhwa reader for Suwayomi-Server

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard
* (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped
* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar
* (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875)
* (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec)
* (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Run without saving changes (#4201, #7326)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Secure Boot option for UEFI guests (#7874)
* (macOS) Scripting: Snapshots are now scriptable objects, and utmctl gains `snapshot` and `discard-state` commands
* (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth)
* (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)

## Changes (v5.0.5)
* ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8.
* Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files
* Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. Previously it was "nearest" for all configurations which led to poor scaling filter for anything with higher resolutions.
* (iOS) Support DirectX 11 with DXMT. Note that due to older iOS version (which supports TrollStore + Hypervisor), compatibility of DirectX titles is worse than macOS.
* (iOS) QEMU: Fixed MMIO BAR bug which prevented large hostmem window from working
* (iOS) Config: Improved RAM limit detection
* (macOS) DirectX 12 is now supported with D3DMetal backend (when available). You must (re)install the latest UTM guest tools experimental 3D graphics driver.
* (macOS) Support holding down Caps Lock key when input capture is enabled (#7840) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Settings: new options to gracefully power down all running VMs on exit (#7829) (thanks @vectorseven)
* (macOS) Settings: support Cmd<->Opt swapping (#7837) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Scripting: add snapshots commands to scripting interface (#7832) (thanks @naveenrajm7)
* (macOS) AVF: Better error message when macOS guest version is too high (#7806) (thanks @sigitkusuma)

## Changes (v5.0.4)
* (macOS) Added support for Neptune backend in virglrenderer for DirectX support
* Localization: Updated German (thanks @Benjamin123-tech)
* Scripting: new reload config and VLAN commands (#7710, #7711) (thanks @GregOriol)
* SPICE: Fixed various bugs in renderer that leads to performance and tearing issues
* SPICE: Fixed a memory leak that could result in large amount of memory use by UTM
* Updated USB icon (#7718) (thanks @tan9)
* Fixed crash in UTMRegistry and memory leak in AVF installer (#7701) (thanks @Casey)

## Changes (v5.0.3)
* Fixed regression in GRUB rendering time due to new graphics backend
* Fixed Vulkan issues on latest Wayland
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Home: Confirm delete when using swipe left (#3086)
* Home: Prevent duplicate VMs from appearing (#7533) (thanks @DevSecTim)
* AVF: Fixed CPU spike and mic loss due to two audio devices (thanks @matapo)
* Scripting: Added ability to get IP address from AVF machines (#7643) (thanks @hellcastter)
* Scripting: Fixed "update registry" for AVM backend (#7664) (thanks @EkkoG)
* Scripting: Improve USB device matching logic (thanks @TronickDev)

## Changes (v5.0.2)
* Environment variables are now logged when debug log is enabled
* Fixed a regression in GL acceleration where desktop might not render correctly (#7626)
* Added geometry shaders support to MoltenVK to enable DXVK (thanks @Anducalliew433) (#7575)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where EAGL backend boots into a black screen (#7587)
* (iOS) Fixed a crash on iOS 15 due to incompatible symbols (#7593)
* (iOS) Fixed verbose logging for graphics backend
* (iOS) Fixed a crash when GL is enabled due to missing support for glDrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex (#7596)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue when after resizing a window if the guest outputs a different resolution size, the wrong texture resolution is used leading to misaligned cursor and warped graphics (#5781)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the window resizes to 0x0 when native scaling is enabled

## Changes (v5.0.1)
* CocoaSpice: Reworked Metal renderer to be faster and have lower latency
* Fixed an issue where a BIOS file with a comma in the filename will fail to load
* Default FPS will now be the maximum refresh rate of the display on macOS and iPadOS (iPhone with ProMotion will still have 60Hz as the default rate but can be overridden to 120Hz through settings)
* (macOS) Fixed issue causing `HV_UNSUPPORTED` on startup with Vulkan enabled (#7579)
* (iOS) Fixed resolution issue on external displays (#6040)
* (iOS) Pinch to zoom will turn off automatically updating zoom from the guest (until reset with the resize button)
* (iOS) Fixed external display menu not updating
* (iOS) Fixed incorrect scale on external displays and connecting an external display will now automatically scale to fit
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where powering off the VM will show the home screen but not terminate UTM in the background

## Changes (v5.0.0)
* Add Venus support for Vulkan (#4551)
* Add Apple Core OpenGL support for OpenGL 4.1 (#4285) (thanks @startergo)

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

apps.localizedDescription: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源与第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。
apps.subtitle: 跨平台漫画阅读器

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式版与升级

- 发布正式版 `1.18.3+249`，集中交付收藏操作、目录导航、归档兼容和依赖解耦后的构建，运行时代码沿用已验收的 RC3。Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 与鸿蒙从同一正式版提交重新构建；保留历史标签，不复用或重命名候选安装包。
- 稳定更新渠道推进至本版；AltStore 与 Winget 元数据依据实际公开安装包更新，Winget 公共源收录需等待 Microsoft 审核。iOS IPA 与鸿蒙 HAP 仍需自行签名侧载。
- 升级前导出并另存完整应用数据备份，保留原漫画文件。共享 WebDAV 数据的设备统一使用兼容版本；回退使用升级前的备份，不让旧版覆盖新版收藏库。覆盖升级保留原数据，无需清库或重新导入。

### 鸿蒙随版分发

- 正式版继续包含同版本的鸿蒙 ARM64 未签名测试版 HAP、`harmonyos-manifest.json`、`harmonyos-SHA256SUMS` 和中英文安装指南。应用源码与平台适配统一在 `main`；普通平台使用官方 Flutter 和根锁，鸿蒙使用独立固定 Flutter OH SDK、CPF 覆盖与受控锁模板。
- 鸿蒙应用为 `VeneraNext (HarmonyOS Beta)`，包名为 `com.github.cyrilpeng.veneranext.harmony`，最低／目标 SDK 为 API 26，版本为 `1.18.3`，构建号为 249。升级须沿用原签名身份／密钥，同一助手或账号不保证同一把密钥。
- 鸿蒙本地导入支持系统提供的目录选择、多选归档，以及带一层可选外部总目录的「漫画合集 ZIP」；结构有多本漫画／单本多章节歧义时由用户确认，取消不入库。目录仅复制导入，PDF 导入、系统分享及生物认证等限制见安装指南。
- 每次候选版与正式版均要求鸿蒙构建成功，准确源码、版本、原生库、资源和全部五项附件须通过生成资产、GitHub 草稿及公开资产核验；缺包或摘要不一致阻止整次发布。草稿按完整分页列表定位唯一标签，再按发布 ID 核验，发布源码与生成产物使用隔离目录。
- 鸿蒙继续标记未签名 Beta，manifest 保留 `signed: false` 和 `runtime_verified: false`。本轮没有鸿蒙真机；构建及资产审核不代表设备签装、阅读、真实数据迁移、覆盖升级或续签已经验收。

### 修复与改进

- 修复 Android 收藏侧栏关闭新建弹窗后不能连续新建的问题；支持收藏夹仅修改名称大小写，保留目录标识、层级、内容、网络关联和追更设置，失败完整回滚。新建与导入按 SQLite 的 ASCII 大小写规则识别重名，自动命名避开占用名称（#143）。
- 收藏子目录返回时先关闭弹窗、退出搜索或多选，再进入真实父目录；保存目录选择期间的返回正常处理。工具栏父目录路径可以点击跳转，窄屏提供上一级按钮，大字体保留完整名称提示；名称中的 `/` 不作为层级数据。保持两级限制及现有备份／同步格式（#123，PR #144）。
- 修复导航容器重建时替换封面转场控制器的问题，控制器与嵌套导航器共用生命周期，取消返回手势及移除导航器时清理悬浮层。这是已确认的生命周期路径修复，原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需新版复测（#129）。
- 新导入同时避开本地库和各收藏夹已占用的同类型漫画 ID，未选收藏夹的导入也不会误关联残留收藏。保留旧记录、原文件与双库原子提交；存储不可读时拒绝冒险复用 ID。
- 适配 `archive 4.6.0`，应用备份与 CBZ 的 Dart 解压显式校验 CRC、解压大小和目录完整性。损坏或截断的备份在替换活动数据前失败，保留原收藏、设置及正常重试能力。
- 从 ZIP 原始文件名字节识别未标记的 UTF-8 和 GBK 中文名称，保留标准 UTF-8、有效 Unicode Path 扩展和 CP437 回退；合法 Unicode 名称不再被二次猜测编码，仍执行原有路径安全校验。
- 官方滚动列表首次尚未通知页码边界时，像素滚动代理立即绑定唯一活动列表，修复早期读取滚动偏移没有客户端的问题；远距离跳页和双列表动画仍按当前几何归属处理。
- 鸿蒙更新说明可滚动，横屏大字体下完整显示同密钥覆盖升级提示；文件／目录临时副本、实际网络请求及取消继续按应用生命周期清理。

### 依赖与维护

- 依赖优先采用官方稳定版，其次固定官方完整 commit，仅保留必要本地补丁。滚动列表回归官方 `0.3.8`，InAppWebView 使用审核后的官方提交，Windows 单包保留实例所有权补丁；SQLite 更新至 `2.9.4`、shimmer_animation 至 `2.2.2+1`。
- 精确保留兼容的官方 `dynamic_color 1.8.1`、网格 `5.7.0` 和 `pdfrx 2.4.7`，本次不扩大 Flutter SDK 更新范围；更新 `crypto`、`image` 和 `archive` 的锁定版本，保持 Flutter Rust Bridge `2.11.1`。
- 必要补丁包与自编 `venera_native`／`venera_saf` 随项目管理，来源、许可证、完整摘要和退出条件纳入校验。PNG 使用官方 LodePNG 20241015，7z 使用 7-Zip 24.09 的已声明 C 解码子集；保留原有算法、版权和逐字节整数读取。
- SAF 保留 Android 文档路径、持久授权、64 位操作、句柄 generation、isolate 交接及关闭／取消清理；QuickJS 固定到 `f5a1f20` 的必要核心安全回移，保留 Map、TypedData、Promise、dispatch 和 port 契约。真实 Provider、原生内存安全、图片处理及反复退出继续作为 CI 门禁。
- Issue 入口按崩溃／启动、阅读性能、导入／数据、网络／WebDAV、界面／其他缺陷和功能建议分类；按情形要求脱敏日志或手动诊断，纯界面与建议使用截图和验收标准。自动检查维护分类与缺失信息提示，材料补齐后更新原提示，保留人工跟进状态。
- 发布元数据、更新日志和正式版验收文档同步至 `1.18.3+249`。主线发版尝试已合为一个提交，本次版本准备单独保留一个中文约定式提交；运行时代码与依赖锁保持已验证的候选内容。

### 已知范围与后续反馈

- #143 的连续新建／仅改大小写与 #129 的原 Android 偶发封面悬浮仍需原设备新版反馈；自动化通过和独立 Android 覆盖升级验证不等于所有设备症状已解决，发布不会自动关闭报告。
- #115 原 Android「导入成功但不可见」的完整根因仍在调查。已提供的设备信息和附件继续复用；新版若仍出现，只需补充实际导入结果、隐藏提示及重启前后变化，有具体新错误再提供必要脱敏片段。
- 收藏目录仍为两级；更深层级、选择器和跨层拖动继续跟进 #123。收藏夹右上角的排序仅操作该目录直接收藏的漫画；同级子目录可在收藏侧栏「排序」中选择父目录后调整，入口说明的完善继续跟进 #155。
- 鸿蒙设备签装、完整功能、真实数据升级及续签仍按实际使用反馈验收；#152 多选入口、#81 分卷 CBZ、#139 白边裁剪作为后续独立需求。

apps.subtitle: iOS 沙盒越权检测与侧载 IPA 审查工具

versions.localizedDescription:
## 🛡️ WQGuard v1.2.1 — 安全加固正式版 / Security Hardening Release

纯 Swift 5.9+ 原生开发、零第三方依赖、100% 本地离线运行的 iOS 静态二进制沙盒逃逸审计工具与多端网络降级护盾。
A native, zero-dependency, 100% offline iOS static binary sandbox-escape auditor and multi-client HTTP Brotli downgrade shield written in pure Swift 5.9+.

---

### 🔥 核心更新与安全修复 / Highlights & Security Fixes (v1.2.1)

1. **CSBlob 双槽（XML + Apple CoreEntitlements DER）完整解码与防遮蔽合并**
   - 完整实现 Apple `CoreEntitlements` v1 (`0xfade7172`) `[APPLICATION 16]` (`0x70`)、`[CONTEXT 16]` (`0xb0`) 及 ITU-T X.690 多字节高 Tag ASN.1 DER 解析，并与 XML 槽位 (`0xfade7171`) 跨切片递归合并数组与布尔权限，彻底阻断“在 XML 槽写入空数组或 `<false/>` 遮蔽 DER 槽真实越权项”的静态审计绕过。
2. **Mach-O 全 ARM 切片并集审计 + ObjC 选择器提取 + 全量 `.appex` 扩展深扫**
   - 对 Universal/FAT 二进制取全部可执行 ARM 切片（`arm64` + `arm64e` 等）的并集进行符号、字符串与 `__objc_methname` 选择器提取，防止 `arm64` 良性壳遮蔽 `arm64e` 恶意载荷。
   - 覆盖主程序、`Frameworks/`、`.app/Dylibs/`、`.app/DynamicLibraries/` 以及 `PlugIns/*.appex` 与 iOS 16+ `Extensions/*.appex` 全部扩展的独立 CSBlob 权限与二进制静态审计；原生支持 `.ipa` 与 `.tipa` 包。
   - 无 App Group 权限但调用 `fsgetpath` / `container_object_get_path` 等沙盒侦察原语的样本前置直接标定高危（`CM-05` / `bad_query`）。
3. **沙盒按需隔离解包与 64 KB 流式配额加固**
   - 组件级路径穿越拦截（支持合法双点文件名如 `icon..png`，阻断 `../` 越界）、64 KB 分块流式 `inflate` 单条目与全包累计解压配额熔断（兼容 ZIP64 `0x0001` 扩展头并拦截 0 字节伪造头部膨胀炸弹），以及临时隔离区 `S_IFLNK` 逃逸符号链接强制剥离。
4. **第三方侧载工具严格零信任策略（Strict Zero-Trust Policy）**
   - 移除对所有第三方侧载器与开发辅助工具（`Feather`、`SideStore`、`AltStore`、`ESign / 全能签`、`GBox`、`Scarlet`、`TrollStore`、`LocalDevVPN`、`StikDebug` 等）的任何内置默认白名单豁免（一律列入前置留意或按命中载荷定级）；内置白名单仅对 `WQGuard` 本身执行精确 Bundle ID、全量 App Group 与全量威胁指标子集强校验。
   - 支持中英混排与驼峰边界的品牌仿冒词元匹配（同时消除对 `NetGuard`、`PostgREST`、`GitGraph`、`ZeroTrust` 等合法应用的误报），并强制 `LockdownInstProxyClient` STARTTLS 叶子证书钉扎校验 Fail-Closed。
5. **五大代理客户端 Brotli 降级护盾（`CVE-2026-111497`）与固件补丁基线校准**
   - 修复 Surge `.sgmodule` 远程 `script-path` 挂载规范，统一加固 Surge / Shadowrocket / Loon / Stash / Quantumult X 响应头拦截脚本（大小写无关遍历与重复头合并检测，返回顶层 `403` 零响应体解压阻断）。
   - 固件雷达新增识别 Apple 官方在 `iOS 27.0`、`iOS 26.7.1` 与 `iOS 18.7.11` 发布的 `CVE-2026-86950` 安全回移植补丁基线。
   - *防御边界提示*：代理层护盾管辖标准 HTTP/1.1 & HTTP/2 头部协商；若面临高危定向威胁，建议在客户端禁用 QUIC/HTTP3 并叠加开启 iOS 系统「锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）」以禁用 WebKit `.woff2` 网页字体渲染。

---

### 📦 发行附件说明 / Release Assets

| 文件 / Asset | 用途 / Description |
|---|---|
| `WQGuard_v1.2.1.ipa` | iOS 独立侧载安装包（兼容 iOS 16.0+，已构建真机 `arm64` Release 包） |
| `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.sgmodule` | **Surge iOS / Mac** 护盾模块 |
| `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.module` | **Shadowrocket (小火箭)** 护盾模块 |
| `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.conf` | **Quantumult X (圈 X)** 重写资源 |
| `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.plugin` | **Loon** 护盾插件 |
| `WQGuard-Brotli-Shield.stoverride` | **Stash** 覆写规则 |

### ✅ 验证记录 / Verification

- `swift test --disable-sandbox -Xswiftc -strict-concurrency=complete`: **681 / 681 tests passing (0 failures)** across 32 XCTest suites (`26` test files), including empirical `/usr/bin/codesign --generate-entitlement-der`, `/usr/bin/lipo` `arm64`+`arm64e`, and `JavaScriptCore` runtime verification.

apps.name: One
apps.localizedDescription: One 是 ONE·一个 的第三方原生 iOS 客户端（SwiftUI，iOS 16+，iPhone / iPad 通用，适配 iPhone Duo）。图文、影视点播、阅读、电台、写真、漫画，系统原生播放器（画中画、AirPlay）和外部播放器，分片多连接并发下载（文件在「文件」App 里），收藏、搜索、评论。安装包是未签名的，由商店用你自己的 Apple ID 签名。
apps.subtitle: ONE·一个 原生 iOS 客户端

versions.localizedDescription:
• 修复：开着系统「旋转锁定」时，视频全屏只显示半截画面
• 改进：竖屏视频进全屏不再被强制转成横屏，全屏画面上多了「横 / 竖」小按钮，点一下就能切换
• 新增：搜索结果里同一个合集的多期折成一行「共 N 期」，点开展开

• 新增：写真、阅读、图文、电台的详情页往下滚出一小段，右下角会浮出「回到顶部」小圆钮，点一下回到最上面
• 新增：详情页最下面（评论上面）多了「收藏」和「回到顶部」两个按钮，看完不用再滑回去点收藏

• 修复：看图页左右翻页时粘手、划到一半卡住、划了没反应；往下滑关闭只在明显竖着拖的时候才接，不再抢横划
• 说明：图片还在加载或加载失败时，也能往下滑关闭；双指缩放、放大后拖动、双击放大、保存图片都和以前一样

• 新增：备份与恢复——「我的 → 备份与恢复」里填一次 WebDAV（坚果云免费版就行）的服务器地址、账号、应用密码，就能一键把收藏、收藏夹、关注的演员、播放进度备份到云端；换证书重装之后再填一次，点「从云端恢复」，东西就都回来了
• 说明：恢复只补上手机上没有的，已有的不会被覆盖；刚重装、手机上是空的时候点备份会被拦住，不会把云端的备份冲掉
• 说明：账号密码只存在这台手机上，不会进备份文件；不用 WebDAV 的话，也可以导出成文件自己存，恢复时粘贴文件的链接

• 新增：长视频起播更快——不用再先下完文件开头的一大段索引才能播，改用 HLS 流播放；短视频、码率高的视频自己会判断，还是用原来的方式，不会变慢；播不了会自动改回原来的方式，接着当前进度继续放。「我的 → 播放器 → 起播速度」里可以关掉
• 说明：下载、外部播放器（Infuse 等）、AirPlay 投屏还是原来的方式，不受影响

• 新增：收藏多了一个开关（「我的 → 收藏」）：关闭后，点一下心形直接收进默认收藏夹，再点一下取消收藏，不用每次都点两下；想放进别的收藏夹，长按心形。打开时和以前一样，点心形弹出收藏夹列表
• 优化：各页底部的说明文字重新整理，一句一行，更简单明了
• 修复：页面显示「Expired token」时，提示改成了怎么处理：到「我的 → 账号」点「换一个新账号」，然后重试
• 新增：用 LCSign 签名的，以后有新版本时，更新提示里会多一个「用 LCSign 更新」，点一下新版安装包就直接导入 LCSign，签名安装即可；没装 LCSign 还是原来的「去下载」

• 新增：看图时往下一滑就能关闭，和系统相册一样（评论区的图片、写真、点开的大图都可以），不用再点左上角
• 优化：放大后拖动更顺滑、松手有惯性；双指缩放跟着手指走；双击放大到点的位置，再双击还原；放大后拖到左右边缘再往外拖，可以直接翻到上一张 / 下一张
• 修复：iOS 17 等旧系统上，从「我的」里的设置页返回后，底部导航栏变成全透明的问题（iOS 26 及以上不受影响）

• 修复：图文详情里点收藏，会打开封面大图的问题
• 同一类问题一起修好：图片旁边的按钮点不准、长按标题会弹出图片菜单

• 新增评论区：影视、图文、阅读、写真、漫画、电台的详情页最下面都能看评论（最热的 3 条），点「查看全部」打开评论弹层——可以切换最热 / 最新、展开楼中楼回复、点开评论里的图；首页主卡下面的评论数点一下也能看
• 长按一条评论可以复制，或者屏蔽这个人（只存在本机，评论弹层左上角可以清空屏蔽名单）
• 评论目前只能看，暂时不能发评论、点赞

• 阅读文章显示完整正文，插图穿插在段落之间（以前只显示开头一句）；收藏页顶部那一大块空白修好了
• 图片加载更稳：只用能正常显示的图片线路，一条不行自动换下一条，不会再显示成坏图
• 播放出错时告诉你怎么办：连不上时提示「换线路」或者切换网络 / 代理节点后「重试」，没网、格式打不开也各有说明，带错误码方便反馈
• 电台迷你播放条：离开电台页面后，底部也能暂停 / 继续 / 关掉
• iPad 和 iPhone Duo：首页大图和推文并排，影视详情横着拿时播放器在左、简介在右（转屏、折叠展开不中断播放），点播 / 发现多列显示，Tab 栏可以收成侧边栏；iPhone Duo 半折时内容按折痕分开
• 细节：iOS 26 起的液态玻璃按钮和 Tab 栏（往下滚自动收起）；系统字号调大后排版不再挤坏；小按钮更好点；开了「增强对比度」时深色页面的文字更清楚

• 首页改成官网首页的样子：每天一页，只显示当天那一篇图文——大图、署名和推文，下面是评论 / 收藏 / 点赞数和期号；左右滑动换日期，点日期打开日历，点卡片进详情，长按大图可以保存
• 首页不再列当天的其它内容（到「发现」「点播」里看），右上角也不再有「大图卡片 / 紧凑列表」切换；点播、发现的切换不变

• 修复 iPad 上横着拿时 App 显示成歪的竖屏：现在 iPhone / iPad 通用，iPad 横屏、竖屏都能正常使用
• iPad 等宽屏上，「我的」页、影视详情页、已下载内容的播放页不再把内容拉到屏幕两边

• 「我的关注」挪到了「收藏」页最上面：点进去能按名字搜索关注的演员，左滑可以取消关注
• 首页、点播、发现的右上角都有排版按钮，点一下在「大图卡片」和「紧凑列表」之间切换（各页各记各的）；首页「左右滑动换日期」的开关挪进了日历菜单

• 首页：左右滑动切换不同日期的内容（往左滑是更早的一天）；日历图标里可以选日期、回到最新，也能关掉左右滑动改成单页
• 演员：「发现 → 演员」可以按名字搜索；演员主页显示作品总数，可以「关注」，作品支持单列 / 双列切换
• 影视详情页：多了演员和标签芯片，点演员进演员主页，点标签按名字搜索；标题下面显示观看 / 收藏 / 评论数
• 直播：「发现」页最上面多了「ONE 直播」入口（在浏览器里打开直播站）；点播分类里的「ONE直播」录播合集也放回来了
• 播放：详情页提前把播放地址准备好，恢复上次进度更快起播；「我的 → 播放器」里新增「显示起播耗时」和「快速起播（实验）」
• 细节：图标按钮补了 VoiceOver 标签；系统开了「降低透明度」「减弱动态效果」时更友好；下载进度和速度的数字会滚动；点播分类多的时候改成下拉菜单

• 已下载的内容，在「我的 → 下载」里点一下就能直接播放，不用联网，也不用去「文件」App 里翻；视频的字幕会跟着下载一起存下来，离线也有字幕
• 自动检查更新：每天检查一次，有新版本会提示你去下载；也可以在「我的 → 检查更新」里手动检查
• 公告：有公告时，输完口令后弹一次（每天最多一次）

apps.name: INSAV
apps.localizedDescription: INSAV 是 insav 的第三方原生 iOS 客户端（SwiftUI，iOS 16+，iPhone / iPad 通用）。四个站点（主站 / 无码站 / 动漫站 / 4K 站）完整适配，浏览 / 搜索 / 系统原生播放（画中画、AirPlay）/ 外部播放器 / 整部下载离线观看 / 登录、收藏、订阅。安装包是未签名的，由商店用你自己的 Apple ID 签名。
apps.subtitle: insav 原生 iOS 客户端

versions.localizedDescription:
• 修复无码站打不开：无码站的域名会不定期更换，原来的自动发现方式已经失效，导致一直连不上；现在改成每次从官方的跳转页现取最新域名，换域名也能自动跟上，发现不了时提示里会说清楚卡在哪一步
• 其余功能同 1.3.0 (5)

• 新增外部字幕：详情页的圆按钮行里多了「字幕」按钮（主站和无码站的片才有，4K 站和动漫站没有番号，没有这个按钮）。点开按番号去外部字幕库搜，选一份马上显示在画面上，可以调同步（提前 / 延后 0.5 秒、5 秒）；选过的字幕下次打开同一部片自动用，不用再搜
• 下载时会把选好的字幕一起存：离线播放也有字幕；存到「文件」App 的下载，成品旁边还会放一份同名 .srt，Infuse、VLC 这类播放器会自动识别
• 用 SenPlayer、Lumenic、Infuse 播放时，自动带上选好的字幕（它们读的是原字幕文件，不带这里调的同步）
• 搜字幕只会把番号发给外部字幕库，别的信息不发；只在打开字幕面板时才搜
• 其余功能同 1.2.0 (4)

• 新增 4 个外部片源（选站页「更多片源」里）：各有栏目首页、搜索、详情和多线路播放，收藏和播放进度存在本机；暂时不支持下载和字幕
• 新增聚合搜索：同一个关键词同时搜所有站点和片源，按来源分组显示
• 外部播放器新增 Lumenic；Lumenic 和 SenPlayer 播放需要请求头的线路时会自动带上
• 选站页重新排版；「我的」页改成短列表，设置点进去再看，「刷新令牌」放在最上面
• 修复 VIP 令牌源在跨日 / 跨月后一直提示「正在续期」的问题（旧版本从 11 月 10 日起会遇到，升级后自动恢复）；去掉已经不再维护的第二个令牌源
• 界面上的说明文字更简短
• 其余功能同 1.0.0 (3)

• 下载：新增「App 内下载」——片子存进「文件」App（我的 iPhone → INSAV），下完自动转成 MP4，可以直接预览，也能交给 Infuse、VLC 这类播放器；转不了或空间不够时保留原文件，设置里可以关掉自动转换。「下载方式」选「自动」时，这台设备上系统的后台下载用不了就自动改用它（要保持 App 在前台）
• 下载失败时说清楚原因，失败的那一行可以复制诊断信息
• 详情页新增「线路检测」按钮（在收藏、下载旁边）：播不了或很慢时，一键看是站点接口、VIP 令牌源还是视频服务器哪一段不通
• VIP 内容：每次点播放都先取最新的令牌；「我的 → VIP 令牌源」里可以立即刷新，并显示每个源的结果
• 修正了「用 VidHub 播放」的跳转
• 其余功能同 build 2

• 换了新图标，桌面显示名改成 INSAV
• 下载：调大了下载的连接数（实际速度看网络）；下好的片子在「我的 → 下载」里离线播放
• 详情里没有真实字幕文件的条目，不再白请求一次字幕
• 其余功能同 build 1：四个站点完整适配、浏览 / 搜索、内置和外部播放器、登录 / 收藏 / 订阅 / 兑换码

• 首个版本：四个站点（主站、无码站、动漫站、4K 站）完整适配，启动时选站点，进去之后顶栏一键切换
• 浏览、搜索、演员 / 片商 / 主题、影评；内置播放器（画中画、字幕）和外部播放器
• 下载：详情页一键下载整部片，之后不联网也能看（离线文件只能在 App 里播放）
• 登录 / 注册、收藏、订阅、兑换码
